summary: Descoberta criativa de features de ENTRADA ousadas/inovadoras p/ XAU 15M sob meta ALIVIADA, focada em ELEVAR WR 40-50 + CORTAR streak<=5, RAW-causal, crivo adversarial

top10: anti_sequence_veto_environment_detector — score 7.5, the ONLY proposal attacking the report's actual diagnosed failure mode (clustered chop losers) instead of repeating select-good; pure detect-bad veto = the validated L2/BPT lens; orthogonal to all triggers; cheap on existing streams. Highest expected streak-cut x lowest fit cost. Verify it does not also suppress winners born in whipsaw/climax.

STOP_RUN_VACUUM — the ONLY feature with a MEASURED outcome separation already on disk (WR 40.5% vs 34.9%, expR +0.214 vs +0.048). Lift direction empirically confirmed at the relaxed band floor. Refine to budget (room/depth/wick) and re-test whether WR holds; do not deploy the 12.5/wk raw filter.

LEG_FRACTAL_FLIP — streak-cut is a GEOMETRIC guarantee (grinding bear leg = identically 0 = cannot fire longs into the trend), SMC-independent (no repaint bias), verified absent from every builder, uses the validated conf-pivot convention. Highest-confidence non-fit streak mechanism.

CBFS (coil_break_failure_skip) — self-referential outcome-grounded regime elimination (market grading its own follow-through), lag-conservative, distinct from chop_score; instantiates the one validated mechanism directly. Pair in a conv stack, never fit the 0.6 cutoff.

LEG_MOMENTUM_DECAY_FADE (acceleration-VETO half only) — the one inter-leg comparison never made; the acceleration veto is robust-by-construction and targets the documented loser cohort (premature fades of accelerating trends). Implement the VETO standalone first; defer the fit-prone fade-selection.

TRAPPED_BREAKOUT_FUEL — trend-immunity by construction (sustained breakout never fades) = airtight streak-cut; SIZES the trapped cohort (new). Re-test the WR lift with a volume-FREE proxy (bars_above_RH + range-excursion) since tick-vol already produced one retracted artifact here.

AGE_OF_MOVE_DECAY — verified absent in every script; right-tail runners originate near a leg's START so prior triggers entered after the tail was paid. TEST AS A STRATIFIER FIRST (WR monotone in extension_pct) before locking any threshold — the cheapest way to confirm or kill the hypothesis.

BUBBLE_EXHAUSTION_FLIP — the only proposal on a genuinely unused orthogonal channel (aggressive order flow, not tick-volume); cluster->drought->flip anchors entry to the exhaustion ORIGIN (concentrate not dilute the tail). Re-extract bubbles, validate on the 3 discrete tiers not a false continuous z.

INTRADAY_VALUE_REJECTION (POC-migration gate role) — a value-distribution channel never built at 15M; the per-day POC-migration gate is a hard environment filter (down-session -> zero longs) endorsed by SVP canon. Implement as the migration GATE, not the rejection trigger; orthogonality check vs op_flow/macro.

SESSION_OPEN_DRIVE_FADE_vs_FOLLOW — first use of the session OPEN as a reference price (trend-day vs rotation-day) at session-character altitude, orthogonal to bar-i triggers, blocks the whole counter-character cohort at once. Anchor by REAL session time (DST bug class already burned here).
result.convergence_plan:
Build all top features as boolean/graded VOTERS, then compose <=4 SETUP DEFINITIONS for the eval phase, each macro/phase-conditioned (the canon: read the phase FIRST; convergence ELIMINATES bad environments, it does not select the runner). All eval stays inside the 8 blocks with leave-one-block-out + sub-window + null permutation; thresholds pre-registered (calibration != validation).

GLOBAL ENVIRONMENT GATE (applies to ALL 4 setups, pure cut_streak — the layer the report says holds the real edge): block entry when anti_sequence_veto fires OR CBFS coil_fail_rate>0.6 OR INTRADAY_VALUE POC migrating AGAINST trade direction OR LEG_MOMENTUM acceleration-veto (legs still strengthening against the fade). This is the streak<=5 machine; measure winners-cut vs losers-cut, never assume.

SETUP 1 — BULL CONTINUATION (macro_4h BULL only): LEG_FRACTAL_FLIP fresh_HL (or AGE_OF_MOVE young_move<=0.5) AND a sweep voice (STOP_RUN_VACUUM) AND session_quality (KILLZONE/SESSION_OPEN_DRIVE follow). conv>=2 of the entry voices, after the global gate. Targets the documented Aug-Oct/25 + Jan/26 runner regime.

SETUP 2 — REVERSAL-AT-EXHAUSTION (any phase, but only after global gate clears chop): STOP_RUN_VACUUM snap-back AND BUBBLE_EXHAUSTION_FLIP (order-flow drought->flip) AND (LEG_MOMENTUM_DECAY 2-of-3 OR liquidity_run_pedigree stacked-shelf). conv>=2. This is the sweep+reclaim+retest visual winner signature, now with an order-flow confirmation the static tests lacked.

SETUP 3 — SESSION-DRIVEN (orthogonal clock/value layer): SESSION_OPEN_DRIVE follow-alignment AND INTRADAY_VALUE_REJECTION (POC-migration with direction) AND killzone_quality>=1. Tests whether the empirically-real +8pp clock lift survives as a standalone setup vs being only a filter.

SETUP 4 — TRAP-FADE (counter-phase, tightly gated): TRAPPED_BREAKOUT_FUEL (volume-free proxy) AND EQ_FAKEOUT_TIMEPOLARITY wick-fast AND room>=2ATR (pool_depletion_distance). conv>=2, hard fire-count floor (>=10 across 8 blocks or discard).

Convergences to test explicitly: (a) does conv>=2 RAISE WR vs any single voice, or does it only shrink n (the recurring trap — conv>=3 reverted to base rate at 4H)? (b) does the GLOBAL GATE cut streak WITHOUT cutting a single right-tail winner (count winners-in-blacked-out windows)? (c) is each gate marginally non-redundant vs macro/regime (the conv<=1-was-BEAR-in-disguise trap)? Promote a setup only if its lift survives leave-one-block-out AND it is not concentrated solely in Aug-Nov/2024.
result.honest_note: Realistic chance of HITTING the relaxed meta (WR 40-50, streak<=5, 1-5/wk) with these features: LOW-to-MODERATE, and almost entirely on the streak<=5 and frequency legs, NOT on a robust WR 40-50 from entry-selection. The standing engine report is unambiguous and was reproduced 4 times: entry-selection on XAU 15M with these indicators is a right-tail substrate where the median trade is a stop, losers are auction-irreducible, and EVERY meta-quality recorte so far was rare + driven by a few trades in one window (Aug-Nov 2024) + failed leave-one-out. None of these 28 candidates overturns that diagnosis; they are sharper instruments aimed at the SAME wall. The two genuinely empirical anchors are sobering: STOP_RUN_VACUUM measured WR 40.5% (only +5.6pp, at the band FLOOR, and its trend-silence/streak claim is unsupported — it fires heavily every block), and KILLZONE measured WR 42.3% but with the runner story INVERTED (60% of runners born OUTSIDE the kill-zones) — i.e. the WR lift is a blunt clock effect that would DISCARD most of the right tail if used to concentrate. So the honest expectation: the streak<=5 target is reachable via the environment-veto stack (anti_sequence_veto + CBFS + LEG_MOMENTUM acceleration-veto + POC-migration gate) because eliminating chop/whipsaw clusters is the ONE mechanism that worked at 4H L2/BPT and is robust-by-construction for the geometric ones (LEG_FRACTAL_FLIP, acceleration-veto). WR 40-50 is plausible as a MECHANICAL consequence of deleting bad-environment losers (denominator-shrink), but a real entry-quality WR lift surviving leave-one-block-out is unlikely given the substrate. The single largest residual risk across the whole backlog is tick-volume: BUBBLE/ERD/IRS/TRAPPED_BREAKOUT/INTRADAY_VALUE all lean on it, this exact program already RETRACTED a tick-volume artifact, and any apparent volume edge must pass a volume-free or coarse-tier cross-check before it is believed. Net: expect 1-2 of the top features to deliver a defensible streak-cut that lands WR at ~40-44% with 1-3/wk; do NOT expect a clean WR>=45 entry-selector — if one appears it is more likely the Aug-Nov-2024 concentration in disguise than a discovery. The right framing is risk-shaping/environment-elimination layered on let-run exit, not a magic entry trigger.

items.name: BUBBLE_EXHAUSTION_FLIP
items.raw_recipe: Re-extract bubble activations per bar from RAW pine_shapes (BUY=plot_0/2/4, SELL=plot_6/8/10; plot_10=LARGE — re-audit mapping per memory), dedup on (bar_index,plot_id), SHIFT1. For LONG at confirmation bar j: trailing window [j-12,j-2] sell_pressure = count/tier-weighted SELL bubbles (use the 3 discrete plot-tiers L/m/s, NOT a fabricated continuous intensity z — serialized size is uniformly 1). CLUSTER = sell tier-sum in top vs trailing-50 median AND its lowest-low bar is the leg extreme. DROUGHT = in 2-4 bars after the cluster-extreme zero new SELL bubbles AND >=1 BUY bubble. Fire LONG at close[j] (first close back above cluster-extreme low) iff CLUSTER then DROUGHT then BUY-bubble, all t<=j. Mirror SHORT. Reconstruct bubble price-location by joining activation time to OHLC.
items.why: Only proposal on a genuinely UNUSED orthogonal channel (aggressive market-order flow) that no builder consumes; not the warned tick-volume. The cluster->drought->flip time-derivative anchors entry to the exhaustion ORIGIN — the one mechanism that could concentrate rather than dilute the right tail. Drought-in-one-way-leg gives a real geometric streak-cut. Caveat: same exhaustion-at-extreme thesis as ABSORPTION_AT_EXTREME but via a distinct sensor; degraded to 3 discrete tiers, validate on that not a false continuous z.

items.name: effort_result_divergence (ERD)
items.raw_recipe: On just-closed bar i (SHIFT1 OB): rel_vol=vol[i]/median(vol[i-1..i-20]); penetration into SHIFT1 zone in ATR; close_position=(close-low)/range (demand); body_frac=|close-open|/range. Fire LONG iff rel_vol>=2.0 AND penetration_into_zone>=0.3*zone_width AND close_position>=0.6 AND body_frac<=0.45. Mirror supply. Entry close[i]. MANDATORY: freeze thresholds pre-hoc; validate effect SIGN via coarse binary splits (rel_vol above/below median, close_position above/below 0.5) + tick-vol-vs-range-expansion cross-check.
items.why: Best-aimed at the population PRIOR (remove no-defender passive touches to raise base-rate a defender exists) rather than predicting magnitude. Causal, novel tensor (vol x own-candle anatomy). Load-bearing risk: rel_vol>=2 rides tick-volume (flagged unreliable; a prior vol x bear confluence was RETRACTED as tick artifact) and may invert the sign by selecting violent continuation. Test sign coarsely before trusting cutpoints.

items.name: absorption_failure_veto (AFV)
items.raw_recipe: From build_causal_primitives all_boxes id->born/last_seen/REMOVED. On bars interacting with SHIFT1 zone over last K=3: if any has rel_vol>=1.8 AND body_frac>=0.7 AND close beyond zone far edge (demand: close<zone_low) -> absorbed=False, VETO long entries on that zone id while breached. Also veto if zone id REMOVED. Mirror supply. ABLATION REQUIRED: measure marginal streak/WR lift OVER zone_removed-alone.
items.why: Causal lockout veto aligned with the one live thread (eliminate bad environments). But marginal value is narrow — if converted-body breach usually coincides with box-removal soon after, AFV collapses to the existing zone_removed flag. Keep only if ablation shows lift beyond zone_removed.

items.name: iceberg_refill_signature (IRS)
items.raw_recipe: Over K=4-6 bars at SHIFT1 demand zone: refill_bars=bars whose low within 0.15*ATR of window min-low AND lower_wick_frac>=0.35 AND rel_vol>=1.2. Fire LONG iff refill_bars>=3 AND |close[i]-close[i-K]|<=0.5*ATR (held shelf) AND latest closes above shelf. TEST GEOMETRY-ONLY FIRST (shared shelf + flat hold + reclaim, NO volume gate); add volume-refill only if geometry survives.
items.why: Inverts zone_mitig_count polarity (refilled shelf = defended, not weaker) — a novel read. But leans hardest on an ABSOLUTE tick-volume threshold (the weakest channel) and overlaps backlog #5. Test geometry-only first; volume only if it survives.

items.name: STOP_RUN_VACUUM
items.raw_recipe: SHIFT1 SMC. SL=lowest-low of k=10..20 fractal (t<=j-2) OR latest EQL. breach=min(low)[j-4..j]<SL*(1-eps). reclaim=close[j]>SL. vac_speed=bars breach-low->first close-back-above SL (<=2). thrust_vol_z=vol z vs trailing-50 median on breach bar (>=1.0, RELATIVE). followthru_fail=2 bars after breach-low make NO new low. Fire LONG at close[j] iff reclaim AND vac_speed<=2 AND thrust_vol_z>=1.0 AND followthru_fail. Mirror SHORT. REFINE to budget: add room-ahead + depth-of-grab + wick-dominance conditioning to reach 1-5/wk and re-test whether WR holds.
items.why: The ONLY feature with a MEASURED outcome separation in the existing probe: WR 40.5% vs 34.9%, expR +0.214 vs +0.048 — lift direction empirically confirmed, lands at the relaxed band floor. Caveat: as-specified fires ~12.5/wk (3-12x over budget) so it is a universe filter not yet selective; tightening could lift OR collapse WR. The trend-silence/streak claim is NOT supported (fires heavily every block). Promote to refinement, not deploy as-is.

items.name: TRAPPED_BREAKOUT_FUEL
items.raw_recipe: SHIFT1 SMC. RH=recent EQH or k-bar swing-high. breakout=max(high)[window]>RH*(1+eps) AND some close>RH. failure=close[j]<RH. trapped_vol_z=sum(vol of bars whose close>RH) vs trailing-50 median (RELATIVE). bars_above_RH=count closes>RH. Fire SHORT at close[j]<RH iff failure AND trapped_vol_z>=2.0 AND bars_above_RH<=4. Contrarian LONG: arm flush-target=range-low; if within M bars price sweeps it and snaps back (STOP_RUN_VACUUM logic) the offside-long flush = highest-quality long. RE-TEST lift with a volume-FREE proxy (bars_above_RH + range-excursion).
items.why: First feature to SIZE the trapped cohort; trend-immunity by construction (sustained breakout -> bars_above_RH large -> never fades a real trend) = airtight streak-cut. WR-lift hinges on trapped_vol_z over tick-volume (one prior tick-vol artifact already RETRACTED in this program) — must prove edge survives a volume-free proxy.

items.name: DOUBLE_SWEEP_DIVERGENCE
items.raw_recipe: Detect two local lows L1@t1,L2@t2 (t1<t2<=j) with L2 in [L1*(1-0.15*ATR/px),L1], separated by a bounce (local high > both by >=0.5ATR). vol2_lt_vol1, range2_lt_range1, rsi_div=rsi(L2)>rsi(L1). Fire LONG at close[j] (first close back above L1 after L2) iff all three. Mirror SHORT on EQH with RSI lower-high. PRE-REGISTER thresholds; test ONLY inside a convergence/elimination stack, never standalone.
items.why: Geometry self-excludes one-way legs (real streak-cut) and rarity fits 1-5/wk. But stacking a 2nd-poke requirement plus 3-way divergence on already-rare geometry drives n toward single digits — exactly the small-N artifact that killed Theory 2. Test only in a conv stack.

items.name: EQ_FAKEOUT_TIMEPOLARITY
items.raw_recipe: SHIFT1 SMC. EQ=nearest EQL(long)/EQH(short), t<=j. excursion_bars=count [j-6,j] with low<EQL. wick_sweep=on deepest breach bar open&close stayed above EQL (only low pierced). body_accept_bars=count closing beyond level. Fire LONG iff close[j]>EQL AND excursion_bars<=3 AND wick_sweep AND body_accept_bars<=1. Mirror SHORT. Report n and WR on firing subset before believing lift.
items.why: Adds principled wick-vs-body/time axis the binary reclaim probe lacked (343/791 have an EQ in window). But rides the same EQ-reclaim chassis that hit the wall; 3-clause conjunctive gate on a thin base -> small n after LONG/SHORT split. Streak-cut only protects against re-fading the SAME broken level, not broad clusters.

items.name: LIQUIDITY_MAGNET_REJECTION
items.raw_recipe: SHIFT1. Magnets (t<=j-1): nearest untouched swing-low, latest EQL, virgin DEMAND OB edge. magnet_hit=low pierces magnet [j-2,j]. instant_reject=within 1 bar close back above AND piercing bar closes top 1/3 range. confluence=#distinct magnet types within 0.5ATR. room=dist to next opposite magnet (>=2.0 ATR). Fire LONG iff instant_reject AND confluence>=1 AND room>=2.0ATR. Mirror SHORT. Scope STRICTLY to conv>=2 elimination gate.
items.why: Verbatim backlog #6, zero novelty vs existing backlog. Its conjunctive stacking makes the already-dead Theory-2 sweep+reclaim STRICTER -> back in the small-N artifact wall. Only the magnet-run-through-in-trend = no-fire streak-cut is worth one test as an elimination gate.

items.name: LEG_FRACTAL_FLIP
items.raw_recipe: Pivots from RAW OHLC only (no SMC): pivot-high at k if h[k]=max[k-w..k+w], w=3, confirmed (k+w<=j); same for lows. Over last ~40 bars (t<=j) extract ordered pivot-lows; count_LL=consecutive lower pivot-lows ending recently; fresh_HL=1 if last pivot-low > predecessor AND its right shoulder closed t<=j. fresh_flip=(count_LL>=2 before) AND fresh_HL AND close[j] above that HL's high. Mirror SHORT. Rank by count_LL depth.
items.why: Reads structure as ORDERED COUNT + FIRST polarity flip — verified absent from every builder (grep). SMC-independent so inherits no repaint bias; uses the validated conf_low/conf_high convention. Streak-cut is a GEOMETRIC guarantee (grinding bear leg = unbroken LL = feature identically 0 = cannot fire longs into the trend), not a fitted threshold. Highest-confidence streak mechanism in the meta-trajectory family.

items.name: NAS_ARRIVAL_CADENCE
items.raw_recipe: From matched-polarity nas_events (t<=j) last ~60 bars: inter_arrival gaps. cadence_accel=mean(last 2 gaps)<0.5*mean(prior gaps). burst_at_extreme=most recent NAS within 3 bars of 30-bar low(long)/high(short). scatter_penalty=#opposite-polarity NAS in 60-bar window. Fire-quality HIGH iff cadence_accel AND burst_at_extreme AND scatter_penalty<=1. PRE-REGISTER 5 thresholds; validate on the dense-cluster subset only.
items.why: The single un-attempted NAS-trajectory read (rhythm, not count); directly encodes the visual gestalt (burst-at-extreme = winner; dense bidirectional scatter = #1 noise). SPARSITY is the operative limit: needs >=4 matched-NAS in window but nas_count median=1/max=5, so it only fires on rare dense clusters; scatter_penalty overlaps already-weak nas_density50. Novel alpha rests on cadence+burst, not scatter.

items.name: RSI_PATH_SHAPE
items.raw_recipe: RSI non-repainting on closed bars. Two recent price-low pivots p1<p2<=j with price[p2]<=price[p1]. rsi_div=rsi[p2]>rsi[p1]+3. rsi_slope_early=rsi[j-2]-rsi[j-5]; rsi_slope_late=rsi[j]-rsi[j-2]; inflect=early<0 AND late>0. Fire-quality HIGH iff rsi_div AND inflect. Mirror SHORT. Fold the INFLECTION increment into a convergence stack; do not run as a fresh isolated trigger.
items.why: Divergence half is already a sub-component of DOUBLE_SWEEP_DIVERGENCE; only the slope-inflection/path increment is new. Many knobs on a thin substrate -> would stack onto the same wall as a standalone WR lifter. Value is as a streak-cut voice in a conv stack (divergence structurally cannot form in clean momentum).

items.name: coil_break_failure_skip (CBFS)
items.raw_recipe: Trailing-only, causal. Over last 120 bars detect every micro-coil-break (bar closing beyond a local 10-bar range extreme by >1.0*atr). Tag FAILED if within next 6 bars price closes back inside that 10-bar range (only count breaks whose 6-bar resolution is fully past -> no look-ahead). coil_fail_rate=failed/total over window. SKIP gate: if coil_fail_rate>0.6 block all new entries this bar. hysteresis: require 5 clean bars to clear. Validate cutoff by jackknife/sub-window/leave-one-block-out + null; NEVER fit the threshold.
items.why: A self-referential, outcome-grounded regime ELIMINATION detector (market grading its own follow-through) — distinct from backlog chop_score (density) and from the 3 failed triggers. Lag-conservative (only past-resolved breaks). Directly instantiates the one validated mechanism (convergence eliminates bad environments). Risk: 0.6 cutoff + window knobs are free; WR lift is only indirect (population-shift). Test as elimination gate, pair in a conv stack.

items.name: squeeze_release_retest (SRR)
items.raw_recipe: SHIFT1 decision. Compression at i-1: 4+ consecutive bars rng<0.7*atr; record coil_hi/coil_lo. RELEASE: bar k closes beyond coil with rng[k]>1.5*atr[k-1] AND |c-o|/rng>0.6 (body-dominant). ENTRY ARMED on later bar m (within 8 of k) where price pulls back within 0.25*atr of broken coil edge but does NOT close back inside; entry=close[m], SL=far side of coil +/-0.3*atr. Direction must match macro_4h phase + zone polarity. Validate as streak-CUT gate FIRST (high plausibility), WR-lift second (pre-refuted).
items.why: Conditions on the volatility TRANSITION + enters on the RETEST with a coil-anchored SL (corrects the probe's finding that thrust-entry chases MAE: medMAE 3.96 vs 3.08). 4-bar coil precondition (base rate ~6-9%) structurally cannot fire in elevated-range chop = real streak-cut. But its displacement-magnitude pillar leans on an axis the repo showed weak (0.45 vs 0.46), and 7 thresholds onto a ~6-9% base = thin armed sample.

items.name: AGE_OF_MOVE_DECAY
items.raw_recipe: From existing leg map (leg_dir, fractal k=2 leg-origin pivot, t<=entry). leg_age_bars=j-leg-origin bar. leg_traveled_atr=(entry_close-leg_origin_price)/atr in leg dir. leg_extension_pct=leg_traveled_atr / rolling median travel of last K legs that CLOSED before entry_t (causal). young_move=1 iff leg_age_bars<=12 AND leg_extension_pct<=0.5. Flag old_move (>=1.0) as hard skip. TEST AS STRATIFIER FIRST: confirm WR monotonically decreasing in leg_extension_pct across strata BEFORE locking any threshold.
items.why: The one comparison the leg map was never used for (age/extension vs the block's own causal leg-travel distribution) — verified absent in every script. Right-tail runners originate near a leg's START, so firing throughout a leg systematically entered AFTER the tail was paid out. Streak-cut (gate closes once extension>=1.0, reopens only on a fresh young leg) truncates the chase-an-extended-move cluster. Core claim is a monotonicity test, checkable before thresholds are locked. k=2 leg-origin is noisy on 15M (measurement error).

items.name: SESSION_OPEN_DRIVE_FADE_vs_FOLLOW
items.raw_recipe: Anchor by REAL session time (NOT naive UTC — DST bug class already burned here): London ~07:00, NY ~13:00 local-session. open_price=open of first bar of most recent session<=entry_t. opening_range=[min(l),max(h)] of first 4 bars IF t<=entry_t else feature undefined. OPEN_DRIVE_UP if price accepted above OR-high without trading back below open; OPEN_REJECT_UP if probed above OR-high then closed back below open. open_alignment=1 if candidate dir agrees with session character. Gate entries on open_alignment. Validate per-session-type lift + trend-day-vs-rotation streak counts.
items.why: First use of the session OPEN as a reference price (Market-Profile trend-day vs rotation-day) — operates at session-character altitude, orthogonal to bar-i triggers, attacks the right-tail at the correct level (trend-days manufacture the runners). On a driving session open_alignment blocks the whole counter-character loss cohort at once. Risks: DST anchor bug; trend-day cohort may be small and partly overlap macro-4h (weak alone).

items.name: KILLZONE_BIRTH_PEDIGREE
items.raw_recipe: killzone bucket of (entry_t mod 86400) into REAL-session UTC bands: LONDON_KZ[06-09), NY_KZ[12-15), ASIA, LONDON_MID, NY_PM, CLOSE_DRIFT. killzone_quality=1 if in {LONDON_KZ,NY_KZ}. Optional prev_session_range_swept refinement. Keep killzone_quality>=1 as a coarse WR/streak filter. DO NOT block ASIA+NY_PM as a runner concentrator.
items.why: EMPIRICALLY MEASURED (n=714 real outcomes): KZ-only WR 42.3% vs 33.9% (+8.4pp, sumR +23.7 vs -49.6) — a real, causal, never-gated lift landing in the relaxed band. BUT the runner-pedigree story is INVERTED by data: 52/87 runners (60%) are born OUTSIDE the kill-zones (ASIA holds the most, 35); LONDON_MID is the WORST bucket (19.1%) while 'dead' NY_PM beats average. It is a blunt clock effect, not institutional pedigree. Keep as a cheap orthogonal filter; reject the runner story; sub-window stability unproven.

families.family: indicator_sequence (ordered FSM / latency over confluence streams)

items.name: anti_sequence_veto_environment_detector
items.raw_recipe: SHIFT1 rolling over last M=30 bars: (a) failed_reclaims=sweeps where close did NOT reclaim within 3 bars; (b) whipsaw_choch=pairs of opposite SMC swing-breaks within <=4 bars; (c) two_sided_bubble=BUY and SELL bubbles both within <=3 bars. env_bad=(a>=2) OR (whipsaw_choch>=2) OR (two_sided_bubble>=2). Veto any entry whose t falls in env_bad window; hysteresis = 5 clean bars to clear. Pre-register as risk-shaping; validate leave-one-block-out + null + density check on bubble/CHoCH streams; VERIFY it does not suppress the few winners it protects.
items.why: The ONLY proposal that attacks the report's actual diagnosed failure mode (losers CONCENTRATED + CLUSTERED in chop/contra-phase) instead of repeating select-good. Pure detect-bad environment veto = exactly the L2/BPT 4H winning lens. Orthogonal to all entry triggers (filters environments). Hysteresis prevents re-enabling mid-cluster. Highest-scored streak-cutter (7.5). Caveats: right-tail reversals can EMERGE from whipsaw/climax (verify it doesn't suppress winners); 5+ thresholds = medium fit risk.

items.name: sweep_then_choch_then_initiative_FSM
items.raw_recipe: Per-bar walker, all streams SHIFT1. S0 swept: low[i]<min(swing_low last L=8..20) AND close[i] reclaims AND inside live DEMAND zone id; record t0,zone_id. S1 micro_choch: first SMC BOS/CHoCH dir=setup at t1, 1<=t1-t0<=6, no opposite break between. S2 initiative: BUY bubble (re-audited mapping) size>=block-median at t2, 0<=t2-t1<=4. S3 nas: NAS LONG first-appearance at t3, 0<=t3-t2<=4, same zone alive. Entry=close(t3+1). Emit fsm_complete + latency vector + reset_count. TEST THE LATENCY VECTOR AS A SOFT CONVERGENCE SCORE over the broader sweep universe, not only as a hard 4-state gate; CUT if fire-count<~25.
items.why: Encodes ORDER + latency + reset — a real new axis (static tests fed the ingredients as simultaneous flags, so initiative-reversals and absorptions were indistinguishable). But conjunctive S0^S1^S2^S3 under tight windows multiplies sparsity into the small-N artifact zone; the streak claim is near-circular (fires-zero-in-chop = just extreme sparsity); S2 needs bubble re-extraction. Test as a soft score, not a hard gate.

items.name: failed_choch_reclaim_trap_FSM
items.raw_recipe: SHIFT1. (1) counter-CHoCH opposite to leg_dir at t0. (2) failed: broken swing level reclaimed by close within K=5 bars AND no second counter break in window. (3) reassert: BOS/CHoCH in leg_dir at t1>failed within W=8. (4) confirm: NAS first-appearance dir=leg_dir inside live matching OB at t2, 0<=t2-t1<=4. Entry close(t2+1). Emit trap_depth_atr (brk_exc_atr), reclaim_speed. PRE-REGISTER a fire-count floor: if total fires across 8 blocks < ~8-10, treat as uninterpretable noise.

items.name: latency_decay_conviction_score
items.raw_recipe: On each fsm_complete candidate: span_bars=t3-t0, gap_max=max inter-step gap, order_purity penalized by reset_count, conviction=exp(-span/tau)*(1/(1+gap_max))*order_purity (tau calibrated per block by median span — CALIBRATION ONLY, never by outcome). Fold arrival_velocity_atr as multiplier. Use as an abstention FLOOR (drop low-urgency candidates), NOT a runner-selecting top-decile rank. Validate as elimination gate with leave-one-block-out + null.
items.why: Novel cross-stream latency read, but its WR-lift claim (conviction monotone in magnitude) is the EXACT claim the engine already refuted; ranking top-decile is the rare-concentrated-thin-slice recipe; bubble link not serialized in per-bar primitives (chain degrades to sweep->choch->nas). Defensible only inverted: as a conviction FLOOR that abstains in gappy regimes.

items.name: discount_with_htf_acceptance_rejection_signature
items.raw_recipe: Causal, forming daily bucket k=floor(t/86400) using ONLY closed 15M bars so-far: day_low_sofar, day_high_sofar, day_close_sofar. lower_wick_frac=(min(day_open,day_close_sofar)-day_low_sofar)/(day_high_sofar-day_low_sofar). rejection = day_close_sofar in upper half AND lower_wick_frac>0.4 AND pos vs PRIOR-day range <0.333. But it is a richer HTF re-expression of sweep+reclaim/wick-rejection (the family that failed isolated at 15M), early-bucket so-far range is noisy/jittery, 3 stacked thresholds on a right-tail substrate. items.name: nested_value_migration_pace
items.raw_recipe: Causal. Last 4 closed daily buckets mid_d=(h+l)/2. drift_up = mid_d strictly increasing over last 3 (or 1D swing-low rising). migration_pace=(mid_d[-1]-mid_d[-4])/ATR14-daily. FIRE LONG-into-DEMAND iff pos_1d<0.40 AND drift_up AND migration_pace>0; mirror SHORT. Test as an environment/streak gate layered on an existing trigger, NOT standalone; pre-register the drift-window to avoid window-fit.

items.name: htf_range_compression_then_discount_tap
items.raw_recipe: Causal. daily_range_atr=(prior_day_high-prior_day_low)/ATR14-daily. compression = daily_range_atr over last 5 closed days in own lower tertile AND contracting (today's-prior < 5-day-mean). FIRE LONG-into-DEMAND iff pos_1d<0.333 AND compression. Self-referential tertiles, SHIFT1. items.name: pool_depletion_distance
items.raw_recipe: At grab bar i: scan prior LB=120 closed bars for opposing pools = confirmed swing-highs (fractal k=2) AND EQH above entry (LONG). near_pool=nearest above close[i]; room_atr=(near_pool-close[i])/atr. pools_cleared_recently=#swing-highs in last 50 bars already taken out. GOOD = room_atr>=2.5 OR (room_atr>=1.5 AND pools_cleared_recently>=2). Mirror SHORT. In a coil every sweep is bracketed by near pools so the room gate stays flat through the whole range and re-engages on breakout = clean bracketed-sweep-loser environment detector. Fit risk: 2.5/1.5/depletion knobs are exactly the 2024-concentration failure shape.

items.name: liquidity_run_pedigree
items.raw_recipe: At grab bar i (LONG): collect confirmed swing-lows + EQL within 0.6ATR band below deepest level swept by low[i], over last 80 closed bars. levels_swept=count whose price>low[i]. equal_lows_flag=1 if >=2 within 0.15ATR (a shelf). GOOD = levels_swept>=2 OR (equal_lows_flag AND shelf cleared) AND close[i]>shelf top. OVERLAY on the existing 166 sweeps (stacked-subset lift vs single-poke complement); pre-register as risk-shaping; jackknife/null within 8 blocks.

Mechanically targets the cascade that fuels right-tail legs. But of 791 candidates only 343 have an EQ in window, the >=2-stacked subset is ~40-80 over 2yr (~0.5/wk) -> small n with tunable bands. Overlay on existing sweeps, not standalone.

items.name: effort_vs_result_sweep
items.raw_recipe: At candidate sweep bar i (low<liq-0.05ATR & close>liq for LONG): sweep_vol_z=(v[i]-mean(v[i-20:i]))/std; penetration_atr=(liq-low[i])/atr[i]; reclaim_frac=(close[i]-liq)/(high[i]-low[i]); effort_result=sweep_vol_z/max(penetration_atr,0.1). GOOD = sweep_vol_z>=1.0 AND penetration_atr<=0.6 AND reclaim_frac>=0.5. Treat as a REFINEMENT of STOP_RUN_VACUUM/ABSORPTION_AT_EXTREME (add the 2-bar reaction), not standalone; leave-one-block-out + conv>=2 gate.

But its headline novelty claim is FALSE vs the written backlog (STOP_RUN_VACUUM #1 and ABSORPTION #5 already specify the identical formula) — a thinner single-bar restatement minus the snap-back confirmation. 3 hard thresholds on tick-volume; shrinks n. items.name: sweep_session_clock
items.raw_recipe: From bar t: hour=(t//3600)%24, dow. kill_zone=1 if hour in 07-10 UTC or 12-15 UTC. dead_zone=1 if 21-01 UTC or Friday after 19 UTC. GOOD sweep = kill_zone AND NOT dead_zone. Use ONLY as a confluence gate on top of the geometric+effort sweep; fully deterministic, no fit. Note the 01h Asia tick-vol spike sits in the dead-zone band.

Strongest leg is streak-cut (nocturnal false-sweep clusters in 21-01 UTC, throttles toward 1-5/wk). Largely duplicates KILLZONE_BIRTH_PEDIGREE; use as confluence on the sweep, not standalone. items.name: INTRADAY_VALUE_REJECTION
items.raw_recipe: Session anchored at each day's first 15M bar (REAL session time, not naive UTC). Build developing value area causally: bins of price weighted by v (tick-vol RELATIVE only, within-session shape), POC=top bin, VAL/VAH=70% volume band edges, recompute each bar t<=j. LONG: vah_rising=POC[j]>POC[j-8]; reject_val=low[j or j-1] pierced VAL but close[j] back inside [VAL,VAH] AND close[j] in lower third of value. Fire LONG iff reject_val AND vah_rising. Mirror SHORT. USE THE SESSION-LEVEL POC-MIGRATION as the GATE (streak role), not the rejection as a standalone trigger; volume-shape robustness check + orthogonality vs op_flow/macro.
items.why: Genuinely orthogonal channel never built at 15M (engine conflates 'value area' with the static OB box; SVP is 4H-canon, never built for 15M). The VALUE is the per-day POC-migration gate: one-sided down session -> vah_rising False all day -> zero longs = hard per-day environment filter (prevents fading a falling distribution), endorsed by SVP canon (above-value=FUEL). Caveat: frozen tick-volume unreliable (relative-only mitigates but POC can wobble); rising-POC partly = price-rising (orthogonality check needed).

items.name: LEG_MOMENTUM_DECAY_FADE
items.raw_recipe: Legs from SMC BOS/CHoCH pivots SHIFT1. Last 3 same-direction legs L1,L2,L3 (t<=j): leg_range_i=|end-start|/ATR; leg_velocity_i=range_i/bars_i; leg_rsi_thrust_i=max RSI excursion. decay = at least 2 of {range3<range2<range1, velocity3<velocity1, rsi_thrust3<rsi_thrust1}. Counter-trend LONG: fire close[j] iff decay AND CHoCH-up just printed (SHIFT1) AND close[j] reclaims L3 start. ACCELERATION VETO: if range3>range2 OR velocity3>velocity1 set feature=0. Mirror SHORT. Pre-register the 2-of-3 rule + k BEFORE fitting; validate the acceleration-VETO as a standalone elimination gate FIRST, separate from the fit-prone fade-selection.

The ACCELERATION VETO is robust-by-construction (feature forced to 0 while legs strengthen) — best fit for the relaxed meta. Fire LONG iff VIRGIN AND rsi_stretch<=35 AND rsi_snap_speed<=2 AND rsi_slope>0. Mirror SHORT (virgin SUPPLY, stretch>=65, snap to <=50). Sweep snap_speed/stretch robustness + jackknife; run as a convergence VOICE, not a standalone gate.

backlog.honest_note: Realistic chance of HITTING the relaxed meta (WR 40-50, streak<=5, 1-5/wk) with these features: LOW-to-MODERATE, and almost entirely on the streak<=5 and frequency legs, NOT on a robust WR 40-50 from entry-selection. surv.name: nested_discount_in_intact_uptrend (Discount-of-Discount, regime-gated by HTF intact-ness, NOT by direction)
surv.angle: The probe shows 48% of 15M bars are in PREMIUM of the prior-day range vs 28% discount — because gold trended up for 2 years. Naive 'buy the discount' therefore fires mostly in down-legs (premium-of-a-downtrend = trap) and filters OUT the trending bull pullbacks where winners live. The fix: discount is only a quality signal when the ENCLOSING HTF range is itself INTACT (higher-high/higher-low structure not yet broken). True discount-of-discount = 15M in lower third of a 1D range whose 1D structure is still making HL, nested inside a weekly that is still making HL. We gate by 'is the bigger container still bullish-intact' (a structural fact), not by macro direction label (already refuted alone).
surv.raw_recipe: Causal/SHIFT1 from RAW 15M only. Resample floor(t/86400)=1D and floor(t/604800)=weekly buckets exactly like build_macro_regime.py; each 15M bar consumes only CLOSED HTF buckets (bisect_right on t_end). For the last N=5 closed daily buckets compute swing via the same fractal-k=2 already in repo: 'daily_intact_HL' = most recent confirmed daily swing-low > prior confirmed daily swing-low AND daily close still above that swing-low. Same for weekly over last N=4. pos_1d = (close - prior_day_low)/(prior_day_high - prior_day_low). FIRE only when pos_1d<0.333 AND daily_intact_HL AND weekly_intact_HL AND the 15M setup is LONG into a DEMAND OB. Pure boolean stack, no fit params beyond the thirds already canonical.
surv.lifts_wr_how: Removes the dominant contaminator: discount readings that are really price collapsing inside a broken HTF container. By requiring the 1D and weekly to still be carving HL while the 15M is in local discount, every entry is a pullback WITHIN an intact uptrend — the structural definition of a buyable dip. This should concentrate the LONG book onto the trending-continuation winners the naive premium-heavy filter was throwing away, lifting WR by cutting the down-leg false discounts.
surv.cuts_streak_how: When the daily/weekly stops making HL (container breaks), the gate goes dark for the whole bear leg — exactly the period that generates loss clusters. Streak is cut by environment-blackout, not per-trade tuning: a structurally broken container produces zero entries until HL re-forms.
surv.novelty: Prior 'MTF value nest' and 'macro-alignment alone' tested DIRECTION (BULL label) or STATIC position-in-range. This is the first to gate discount by structural INTACT-NESS of the enclosing range (HL-still-carving) at TWO nested HTFs simultaneously, fractal-recursively — a container-integrity condition, not a direction condition.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: The right-tail wall came from firing in mixed regimes where discount was indiscriminate. By demanding nested container integrity, it only fires in the one context where mean-reversion-to-demand has positive drift (intact uptrend pullback), which is where the fat right-tail trades historically originated — it aligns the entry filter with the source of the right tail instead of fighting it.
surv.sharpest_reason: Causally clean and genuinely novel: the existing _probe_nested_value_feasibility.py confirms the cited contaminator is real (premium 48% / discount 28% / mid 24% — naive discount fires mostly in trended-up-premium-vs-collapse), and the exact infra (fractal k=2 on closed HTF buckets, bisect_right on t_end, pos_1d thirds) already exists, so the recipe is implementable SHIFT1/close-only with no new fit params. Prior refuted work (Theory#1 with_macro, 'macro-alignment alone', 'MTF value nest') gated by DIRECTION LABEL or STATIC position — never by nested HL-container-integrity at 1D AND weekly. Auction rationale is sound (buyable dip = discount inside an intact container). The two real hazards that keep this at 7 not higher: (1) the conjunctive 1D-intact AND weekly-intact AND discount AND DEMAND-OB stack will be sparse — weekly fractal-k2 over ~105 buckets risks dropping below the 1-5/wk floor and reviving the small-n artifact that killed Theory#2 (n17, '2 trades=83%'); (2) 'HL still carving' partly re-expresses swing_dir>0 already inside the refuted macro label, so the test MUST isolate marginal WR lift vs plain BULL-macro and report fire-rate before accepting — the novelty is the nesting+discount conditioning, not the BULL component.

surv.name: htf_range_compression_then_discount_tap (volatility-nested discount: tap demand only when the HTF range is COILED)
surv.angle: Discount-of-discount alone is a location. Add a SECOND nesting axis — volatility state of the container. A tap into nested demand from a COMPRESSED daily/weekly range (low daily-range-in-ATR, contracting) is a coil-spring entry; the same tap from an already-EXPANDED range is late, exhausted, mean-reverted. Auction logic: value forms in balance (compression); the breakout out of balance is the move you want to be early on. Discount + compression = positioned before expansion; discount + expansion = chasing.
surv.raw_recipe: Causal from RAW 15M. daily_range_atr = (prior_day_high - prior_day_low) / ATR14-of-daily (ATR built on the 1D resample, same EMA/TR machinery as primitives). compression = daily_range_atr over last 5 closed days is in its own lower tertile AND contracting (today's-prior < 5-day-mean). weekly analog optional. FIRE LONG-into-DEMAND only when pos_1d<0.333 AND compression==True. All thresholds are self-referential tertiles (no absolute USD constants), SHIFT1, closed-bucket only.
surv.lifts_wr_how: Separates buyable-dip (coiled range, expansion ahead) from exhausted-dip (already-expanded range, move likely done). Compression is a leading condition for directional follow-through, so entries cluster before the impulsive leg that turns a stop-median trade into a runner — raising the share of trades that hold and lifting WR by avoiding late taps into spent ranges.
surv.cuts_streak_how: Expanded/trending-fast environments (where 15M dips get steam-rolled or chopped) are blacked out because daily_range_atr is high — these are precisely the whipsaw clusters. Compression-gating mutes entries during high-volatility chop, cutting consecutive stops.
surv.novelty: Volatility-state of the ENCLOSING HTF range as a nesting axis for discount has never been tested here — prior work used only price-position nesting. Compression-then-tap couples WHERE (discount) with WHEN (coiled), a 2D nest no basic trigger touched.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: Right-tail trades are born from expansion out of balance. Filtering for compression positions the entry at the balance-to-expansion transition — the structural birthplace of the right tail — instead of firing uniformly across volatility states where most taps are noise.
surv.sharpest_reason: Causal and genuinely novel as a coupling (volatility-state of the enclosing HTF range as a SECOND nest on discount — distinct from the already-weak NAS-in-zone/sweep/EMA triggers), with real Auction rationale (value-in-balance precedes expansion-out-of-balance). But the WR-lift leg is its weakest and is partly pre-refuted: the existing probe _DA_volatility_transition_feasibility.py recorded a NEGATIVE finding that compression-release entries chase MAE (medMAE 3.96 vs 3.08 baseline) and do NOT lift WR — and the engine's standing diagnosis is that 15M entry-selection is a right-tail substrate with no magnitude alpha (losers auction-irreducible; lever lives in exit/regime/risk-shaping). The double self-referential tertile gate (lower-tertile AND contracting AND pos_1d<0.333) on ~2yr is high fitting risk for any WR claim. It survives as KEEP only because its DEFENSIBLE channel is streak-cut, not WR: blacking out expanded/already-trending volatility regimes is a legitimate whipsaw-cluster blackout mechanic — so test it in Stage-B strictly as an environment/streak filter (with the prior probe's enter-on-retest correction), not as a WR-lifter.

surv.name: recursive_demand_alignment (price sits in DEMAND OB at 15M AND 1D-resampled AND weekly-resampled simultaneously)
surv.angle: The Custom OB engine only draws zones on the 15M chart. But a true discount-of-discount means the 15M demand zone should geometrically OVERLAP a demand region of the higher timeframe. Since we cannot re-run the OB indicator on resampled bars, we PROXY the HTF demand zone from RAW structure: the last confirmed swing-low shelf of the 1D/weekly resample. Entry quality = a live 15M DEMAND OB whose price band is INSIDE the prior-day-low shelf AND inside the prior-week-low shelf. Three nested demand confluences stacked.
surv.raw_recipe: Causal. 15M DEMAND OB: from primitives zones (text==DEMAND, id alive, born_t<=entry). HTF demand shelf (proxy, RAW-derived): band [swinglow, swinglow+0.25*daily_range] of the most recent CONFIRMED daily swing-low (fractal-k=2 on closed daily buckets); weekly analog. overlap_1d = 15M zone band intersects daily demand shelf; overlap_w = intersects weekly demand shelf. FIRE LONG only when 15M DEMAND OB active AND overlap_1d AND (overlap_w OR weekly-shelf within 0.5*ATR-daily). SHIFT1, closed-bucket HTF only. No new indicator — shelves derived from the same swing code already in build_macro_regime.py.
surv.lifts_wr_how: A 15M demand zone floating in mid-range has weak institutional backing; one stacked on the HTF swing-low shelf is where larger-timeframe buyers defend. Requiring geometric overlap at three nested scales selects the demand taps that have real HTF support behind them, which hold more often — directly lifting LONG WR by demoting orphan 15M zones.
surv.cuts_streak_how: When the 15M zone is NOT aligned with any HTF shelf (the common case in trends/extensions), no trade — so the dense stretches of unsupported 15M-zone taps that generate stop streaks are skipped.
surv.novelty: Recursive zone-overlap across THREE timeframes using an HTF-demand PROXY built from RAW swing structure (sidestepping the indicator-not-runnable-on-resample limit) has never been done. Prior nesting used range-position; this uses geometric zone intersection at every scale.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: The fat right-tail demand taps in gold come from HTF-supported shelves where size defends and price re-auctions up multiple sessions. Targeting tri-scale overlap aims the filter directly at HTF-backed shelves — the structural origin of the multi-day runners — rather than at geometrically-random 15M zones.
surv.sharpest_reason: Causally buildable on existing infra: build_macro_regime.py already resamples 15M->HTF and computes confirmed fractal-k=2 swings on closed buckets, so the daily/weekly demand-shelf proxy is a direct, look-ahead-free extension (SHIFT1, confirmed pivots j+K<=i). It is genuinely novel vs the failed isolated triggers: prior MTF was soft confluence/range-position with 'HTF=context not gate' (FEATURE_MAP l.62), whereas this is geometric tri-scale zone INTERSECTION of the 15M OB band with HTF swing-low shelves — a real premium/discount-recursion thesis that demotes orphan mid-range 15M zones (the structural origin of stop streaks) and selects HTF-backed shelves where size defends (the right-tail multi-session runners). Main hazard is fit/sparsity: the shelf width 0.25*daily_range and 0.5*ATR weekly tolerance are free knobs and the overlap-AND on 1-5 trades/wk can crush n into single digits where lift is unverifiable — so band widths must be PRE-REGISTERED, not tuned, and treated as calibration-not-validation per canon. Net: structurally justified, causal, non-redundant, worth testing.

surv.name: discount_with_htf_acceptance_rejection_signature (nested value + how the HTF bar is REACTING to the discount)
surv.angle: Position-in-range is static; what matters in Auction Theory is whether the HTF is ACCEPTING (closing into) the discount or REJECTING it (wicking out, closing back up). A 15M long fired while the CURRENT-but-still-forming daily bar is rejecting its own lows (long lower wick, close in upper half despite a deep low) is buying into HTF-confirmed rejection of discount. Fired while the daily is accepting lows (close near low) is catching a falling knife. We read the daily reaction causally from the 15M bars already accumulated in the live daily bucket.
surv.raw_recipe: Causal — this uses the LIVE/forming daily bucket but ONLY bars already CLOSED at 15M (no future). For the current daily bucket k=floor(t/86400), aggregate all CLOSED 15M bars so-far: day_low_sofar, day_high_sofar, day_close_sofar=current 15M close. lower_wick_frac = (min(day_open, day_close_sofar) - day_low_sofar)/(day_high_sofar - day_low_sofar). rejection = day_close_sofar in upper half of day-so-far range AND lower_wick_frac>0.4 AND pos vs PRIOR-day range <0.333 (still in discount of yesterday). FIRE LONG when rejection AND 15M DEMAND OB. Strictly causal: only completed 15M bars feed the forming-day aggregate.
surv.lifts_wr_how: Distinguishes confirmed HTF rejection-of-discount (buyers already showing up, daily reclaiming its lows) from unconfirmed acceptance (still falling). Entering on the rejection signature catches the dip AFTER the higher timeframe has demonstrated defense, sharply raising the odds the demand holds and lifting WR over blind discount taps.
surv.cuts_streak_how: On days the daily is accepting lows (no lower-wick reclaim), the gate stays closed — these acceptance days are the trend-down/knife sessions that produce loss clusters. Streak is cut by refusing entries until the HTF bar itself shows rejection.
surv.novelty: Reading the FORMING higher-timeframe bar's acceptance/rejection wick signature — causally, from completed 15M sub-bars — as an entry gate has never been tested. Prior acceptance work (in FEATURE_MAP item) was zone-local on 15M, never the HTF bar's own intrabar reaction to discount.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: Right-tail reversals from discount begin with an HTF rejection wick (the defended low). Gating on that wick signature times the entry at the structural ignition of the reversal rather than uniformly across the discount, converting more taps into the held, multi-bar moves that form the right tail.
surv.sharpest_reason: Genuinely novel axis vs the four failed-isolated triggers: prior acceptance/rejection work was zone-local on the 15M bar; this reads the FORMING HTF (daily) bar's own intrabar wick signature — built strictly from already-closed 15M sub-bars in the live bucket — as the entry gate. That is causally feasible (no future leak: day_low/high/close_sofar use only completed 15M bars) and structurally legitimate Auction-Theory logic: a defended discount low (long lower wick + close in upper half + still in prior-day discount) is the structural ignition of a right-tail reversal, distinct from acceptance-of-lows knife sessions. The streak-cut mechanism (refuse entry until HTF shows rejection) plausibly skips the trend-down/acceptance days that produce loss clusters, which directly targets the stated goal. CAVEATS keeping this from a high score: (1) it is essentially a richer, HTF-lifted re-expression of sweep+reclaim/wick-rejection — the same reclaim instinct that already failed isolated at 15M — just measured one timeframe up, so redundancy with the failed family is non-trivial; (2) early in a daily bucket (first few 15M bars) the so-far range is tiny and noisy, making lower_wick_frac and upper-half tests unstable/jittery — a real fit-and-noise hazard the recipe doesn't address; (3) three stacked thresholds (wick>0.4, upper-half, pos<0.333) on a 2-year sample with the known right-tail substrate invite curve-fit. KEEP because the HTF-forming-bar reaction axis is genuinely untested and has real structural rationale that could separate defended-discount from falling-knife — but require an intrabar-maturity guard (min bars/min range elapsed in the day bucket) and pre-registered thresholds before trusting any WR lift, since the underlying substrate is right-tail and most of the apparent edge could be selection on the rare good recortes.

surv.name: premium_distribution_skip (environment detector: blackout entries when the book is structurally in PREMIUM-of-downtrend)
surv.angle: This one is purely a STREAK-CUTTER / environment veto, not a trigger. The probe found premium dominates (48%). The dangerous regime is PREMIUM position WHILE the enclosing HTF is making LOWER-highs (price is high in yesterday's range but the daily/weekly structure is bearish-intact) — that is a distribution/exhaustion zone where long entries get sold and short-into-supply entries also fail on snapback. Detect it and BLACK OUT all entries (both sides) for the duration, rather than trying to pick a trigger inside it.
surv.raw_recipe: Causal. pos_1d>0.667 (premium of prior-day range) AND daily structure making LH (most recent confirmed daily swing-high < prior, fractal-k=2 on closed daily buckets) AND weekly not making HL. When all true -> entry_blackout=True for that 15M bar (suppress BOTH long and short candidates). Derived entirely from existing swing code + range-position; SHIFT1, closed-bucket HTF.
surv.lifts_wr_how: Indirect WR lift: it removes the systematically-negative-expectancy environment from the trade population. Whatever trigger is used for entries, restricting it to NON-blackout bars raises aggregate WR by deleting the regime where every entry style historically bled.
surv.cuts_streak_how: This is its primary job: premium-of-downtrend distribution zones are where consecutive stops cluster (longs sold into supply, shorts squeezed). A blanket blackout over that detected environment directly truncates loss streaks to <=5 by never trading the cluster-generating regime.
surv.novelty: A dedicated SKIP layer built from the premium-side of the same nested-value lens — using the OBSERVED premium-dominance asymmetry as a detector rather than ignoring it — is new. Prior work tried to find triggers; none built a premium-distribution environment veto from nested structure.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: It does not try to find right tail inside bad environments — it concedes the wall there and removes those bars. By shrinking the denominator to environments that historically host the right tail (intact pullbacks) and excising the premium-distribution regime that never did, it raises the density of right-tail-capable setups in the surviving population.
surv.sharpest_reason: Causal and structurally honest: it concedes the right-tail wall instead of pretending to pick a trigger inside it, and builds a BOTH-SIDES environment veto from the premium-of-downtrend nested-value lens — a SKIP layer, not a trigger, which is genuinely orthogonal to the failed NAS-in-zone/sweep/EMA triggers. The premium-while-HTF-making-LH distribution zone is a legitimate Auction-Theory cluster-generator (longs sold into supply, shorts squeezed on snapback), so a blanket blackout there has a real mechanism to truncate loss streaks and lift aggregate WR by deleting a systematically-negative regime rather than fitting one. Risks keeping it medium not low: (1) the conjunction pos_1d>0.667 AND daily-LH AND weekly-not-HL is a 3-condition AND that may fire too rarely on 15M to actually move the 1-5/week population — and rare-firing vetoes are exactly where curve-fit hides; (2) 'daily structure making LH' largely overlaps macro-alignment (already weak isolated) and the bear-leg regime work, so the marginal cut beyond regime!=BULL must be proven non-redundant on the corpus (same trap as conv≤1 being regime-BEAR in disguise); (3) being a denominator-shrinker, its WR lift is mechanically guaranteed if it removes any losing bars, so the real test is whether it removes losers WITHOUT cutting a single right-tail winner — that must be validated on the actual 15M trade population (count winners-in-blackout) before crediting it, not assumed. KEEP for validation as a streak-cutter/skip layer; the structural rationale is real and the SKIP framing is the correct response to a right-tail substrate, but pre-register it as a veto measured by winners-cut vs losers-cut and prove orthogonality to existing regime/macro filters before promotion.

surv.name: nested_value_migration_pace (is the HTF range MIGRATING up while 15M is in discount? — value-area drift as confirmation)
surv.angle: Static discount ignores DRIFT. The highest-quality nested-long is a 15M discount tap occurring while the higher-timeframe value/range itself is MIGRATING UPWARD bar-over-bar (each closed daily range shelf higher than the last). That is buying a shallow pullback inside an actively-climbing value area — distinct from buying a discount while the HTF range is flat (balance, lower edge) or descending (trap). Pace and direction of the container's drift is the third nesting axis after position and volatility.
surv.raw_recipe: Causal. For last 4 closed daily buckets compute mid_d = (h+l)/2. drift_up = mid_d strictly increasing over the last 3 closed days (or 1D swing-low rising). migration_pace = (mid_d[-1]-mid_d[-4]) / ATR14-daily. FIRE LONG-into-DEMAND when pos_1d<0.40 AND drift_up AND migration_pace>0 (range climbing). For shorts mirror with descending mid_d and pos_1d>0.60 into SUPPLY. SHIFT1, closed daily buckets only; thresholds self-referential.
surv.lifts_wr_how: Selects pullbacks inside a value area that is demonstrably climbing — the textbook continuation long — and rejects discounts that occur because the whole container is sliding down. Aligning the entry with confirmed upward container migration concentrates the book on continuation winners, lifting WR over direction-agnostic discount taps.
surv.cuts_streak_how: When the container stops migrating up (flat or descending mid), longs are suppressed; this blacks out the topping/rolling-over transitions that spawn loss runs. Directional drift requirement gates out the regime changes that cause clusters.
surv.novelty: Container DRIFT/migration-pace as a nesting confirmation — measuring whether the enclosing range is itself moving, not just where price sits in it — has not been tested. It adds a velocity dimension to the value-nest that all prior static-position tests lacked.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: Right-tail continuation runs happen when a pullback lands inside an actively-migrating value area and the migration resumes. Conditioning on confirmed upward migration times the entry to the continuation engine that produces those runners, instead of firing on discounts that lead nowhere because the container is not moving.
surv.sharpest_reason: Causal and genuinely adds an untested axis (container VELOCITY/drift, not just static premium-discount position which the _probe_nested_value_feasibility.py already grounded). But its WR-lift half is the weak side: 'daily mid strictly increasing over 3 closed days' is highly collinear with the existing macro 4H regime (swing∧EMA50), and the report's central finding is that the right-tail substrate is regime-invariant — Theory 1 (macro-aligned) and Theory 3 (continuation pullback, WR 27%) both hit the same wall, and 'macro-alignment alone' is already in the tested-weak list. So drift-up risks being macro-up in a velocity costume, and fitting risk is high because a 'climbing daily mid' filter lights up exactly in the one concentrated Aug-Nov/2024 trend window that already drove the marginal recortes. KEEP narrowly — and only because the STREAK-CUT/environment-detection half (suppress longs when the container stops migrating = black out topping/rolling-over transitions) targets where the report says the real lever lives (regime/risk-shaping, not entry-magnitude). Test it as an environment/streak gate layered on an existing trigger, NOT as a standalone continuation entry, and pre-register the drift-window to avoid window-fit.

surv.name: effort_vs_result_sweep (absorption-divergence grab)
surv.angle: Auction effort-vs-result. A genuine stop-run that will follow through is a HIGH-effort spike (big volume) that produces a SMALL net-result penetration and then snaps back fast — liquidity was grabbed and rejected. A sweep that will FAIL is either low-effort drift through the level (no real liquidity event, price just trending past) or high-effort + high-result (true breakout, the level is gone). The prior sweep detector measured only geometry (depth, reclaim strength) and never measured the VOLUME spent to achieve that penetration. Effort/result is the classical Wyckoff discriminator and it is exactly the missing axis.
surv.raw_recipe: At candidate sweep bar i (low[i]<liq-0.05ATR & close[i]>liq for LONG; mirror SHORT): compute sweep_vol_z = (v[i] - mean(v[i-20:i]))/std(v[i-20:i]); penetration_atr = (liq-low[i])/atr[i]; reclaim_frac = (close[i]-liq)/(high[i]-low[i]); effort_result = sweep_vol_z / max(penetration_atr,0.1). GOOD-grab signature = sweep_vol_z>=1.0 AND penetration_atr<=0.6 AND reclaim_frac>=0.5 (big effort, tiny result, closes back in upper half). All from RAW v/OHLC of CLOSED bars; entry close[i+1] SHIFT1.
surv.lifts_wr_how: Separates the high-volume-rejection grab (institutions absorbed sells at the low and lifted price) from the low-volume drift-through and the high-volume-genuine-breakdown. The prior n17 sweep cut had WR47% using geometry alone; conditioning on effort_result high-band should concentrate WR by dropping the drift-through majority (the bulk of failed sweeps are low-effort non-events that geometry can't see). Targets the 40-50 band by keeping only sweeps where a real liquidity transfer occurred.
surv.cuts_streak_how: Low-effort sweeps cluster in chop (price wandering across a level repeatedly with thin volume) — the exact environment that produced the loss streaks. Requiring sweep_vol_z>=1.0 mechanically skips chop-grade sweeps, so consecutive thin-volume false grabs never fire, capping streak.
surv.novelty: Volume was present in RAW the whole time but every prior sweep/zone test used pure geometry (depth, reclaim_str, penetration_pct). No effort-vs-result / volume-z classifier on the sweep bar has ever been computed. The basic triggers were geometry-only by construction.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: The right-tail problem is that geometry-defined sweeps are a mix where 95% are non-events. Effort/result removes the non-events at the source rather than hoping exit/regime rescues them, so the surviving population is enriched for real liquidity transfers — the only sweeps that have follow-through magnitude. It attacks selection where the magnitude actually originates (the volume of the grab), not the shape.
surv.sharpest_reason: Causal and structurally sound (Wyckoff effort-vs-result), and the volume channel IS the single axis untested across all 4 executed theories (detect_sweep_universe.py used geometry only: sweep_depth/reclaim_str, zero volume) — so novel_vs_tested is true. BUT the candidate's headline novelty claim ("no effort/result or vol-z on the sweep bar has ever been computed") is FALSE against the existing written backlog: TRAP_FEATURES_PROPOSALS.md #1 STOP_RUN_VACUUM already specifies thrust_vol_z>=1.0 on the breach bar, and #5 ABSORPTION_AT_EXTREME already defines the identical formula effort_result=volume_z/(progress/ATR+eps) verbatim. This candidate is a thinner single-bar restatement of #1∪#5 minus the snap-back/followthru confirmation that makes #1 stronger. KEEP only as a refinement of #1/#5 (add the 2-bar reaction), not as standalone discovery. Fitting risk HIGH: three hard thresholds on tick-volume (memory flags tick-volume unreliable; only mitigated by relative z-use), and — per XAU_15M_ENGINE_REPORT — it sits on the exact right-tail entry-selection substrate where the prior geometry sweep already hit WR47% n17 and was killed as SMALL_N_ARTIFACT (leave-out -9); layering effort shrinks n further, deepening that fragility. WR-lift low; streak-cut medium (vol_z>=1.0 genuinely skips thin-volume chop sweeps). Test inside the 8 blocks with leave-one-block-out and as a conv>=2 elimination gate, not as a magnitude selector.

surv.name: pool_depletion_distance (room-to-next-liquidity gating)
surv.angle: A reclaimed sweep can only RUN if there is open space to the next opposing liquidity pool. If the next swing-high/EQH (for a LONG) sits right above entry, the move has no fuel — it sweeps the low, ticks up, and immediately hits sellers parked at the near pool. Sweeps that run are the ones launching INTO a vacuum. This refines the backlog 'room_to_run'/'liquidity_pool_magnet' into a depletion-aware causal measure tied to the sweep, which was never built.
surv.raw_recipe: At grab bar i: scan the prior LB=120 closed bars for opposing pools = confirmed swing-highs (fractal k=2) AND EQH SMC levels above entry (LONG). near_pool = nearest such level above close[i]; room_atr = (near_pool - close[i])/atr. Also count pools_cleared_recently = number of swing-highs in last 50 bars already taken out (depletion = bullish, overhead is thinning). GOOD = room_atr>=2.5 OR (room_atr>=1.5 AND pools_cleared_recently>=2). Mirror SHORT with swing-lows/EQL below.
surv.lifts_wr_how: Directly removes the structurally-capped sweeps (reclaim valid but immediately into overhead supply) which are a large share of the WR27-47 losers. Keeping only sweeps with a clear runway should raise hit-rate because the target (next pool) is reachable for >=1R before the first resistance. It separates entry-good (vacuum ahead) from entry-bad (wall ahead) on a pure structural axis orthogonal to the grab quality.
surv.cuts_streak_how: In a coiling/range, every sweep is bracketed by near pools on both sides — room_atr is always tiny. The room gate therefore stays flat through the entire coil, skipping the cluster of bracketed-sweep losers that drive streaks, and only re-engages once price breaks the range and opens space.
surv.novelty: room_to_run/liquidity_pool_magnet were named in the backlog but never implemented as a causal pool-distance + depletion-count measure anchored on the sweep bar. Prior tests never measured what is ABOVE/BELOW the entry, only the entry geometry itself.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: The right tail is made of trades that travelled far. Travel-distance is bounded by the nearest opposing pool. By gating on room, we are directly selecting for the only structural precondition of a large-R outcome — there is no way to be a right-tail winner with a pool 0.5ATR overhead. This converts an outcome property (magnitude) into a pre-trade structural filter.
surv.sharpest_reason: Causal and not a literal repeat: `room_to_run_atr` was BUILT (real spread p25=0.77/med=1.9/p75=3.46 across 791 candidates) but only as a distance-to-OB/EQ-edge descriptor — never gated/evaluated as a WR separator, and the two distinguishing elements (fractal swing-high pools k=2, and the `pools_cleared_recently` depletion count) were never implemented. The rationale is genuinely orthogonal to the grab geometry that failed in all 4 theories: a reclaim into a 0.5ATR-overhead wall structurally cannot be a right-tail winner. Sharpest, most defensible claim is the streak-cut mechanism — in a coil every sweep is bracketed by near pools on both sides, so the room gate stays flat through the whole range and only re-engages on breakout, which is exactly an environment-detector for the bracketed-sweep loser clusters (and directly serves the relaxed meta's streak<=5 goal). KEEP, but the real hazard is fitting_risk: the report's hard-won finding is that every quality cut so far was rare + concentrated in Ago-Nov/2024 + LOO-fragile, and 'convert magnitude into a pre-trade filter' with tunable 2.5/1.5/depletion>=2 knobs is precisely that failure shape — so it must be validated as a gate under leave-one-out + sub-window robustness against the known 2024 concentration, not promoted on aggregate WR lift.

surv.name: liquidity_run_pedigree (multi-level stacked-grab vs single poke)
surv.angle: Sweeps that run often clear a CLUSTER of stacked liquidity (equal lows / a swing-low shelf) in one move — a stop-cascade that exhausts sellers — whereas failing sweeps prick a single isolated level. The grab that takes 2-3 stacked pools in one bar/leg has flushed the book; the single-level poke leaves resting liquidity that re-pressures price. This is a structural 'how much was actually swept' read, never computed.
surv.raw_recipe: At grab bar i (LONG): collect all confirmed swing-lows + EQL within a 0.6ATR band below the deepest level swept by low[i], over last 80 closed bars. levels_swept = count of those whose price > low[i] (i.e. now taken out by this bar's low). equal_lows_flag = 1 if >=2 of them lie within 0.15ATR of each other (a shelf). GOOD = levels_swept>=2 OR equal_lows_flag with the shelf cleared. Combine with reclaim (close[i]>shelf top). All causal from confirmed-fractal levels of closed bars; entry close[i+1].
surv.lifts_wr_how: Stacked-stop flushes are the high-conviction grabs; single pokes are noise. Filtering to multi-level/shelf-clearing sweeps should lift WR by dropping the isolated-poke losers. It is the liquidity-quantity analog of effort_vs_result — instead of asking how much volume, it asks how much resting liquidity was actually removed, which is the structural cause of a one-way move afterward.
surv.cuts_streak_how: Isolated single-level pokes recur in indecisive tape; demanding a stacked-shelf clear means the engine ignores the run of single-poke false sweeps that accumulate losses, firing only on the rarer genuine flush.
surv.novelty: No prior test counted how many distinct liquidity levels a single sweep removed, nor detected equal-low/equal-high shelves as a precondition. EQH/EQL were only used as the single nearest level in the DA feasibility probe; the stacking/shelf structure was never read.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: A stop-cascade that clears a shelf is mechanically what produces the explosive right-tail legs (forced liquidation feeds the move). Selecting for shelf-clears pre-loads the population with the exact microstructure event that generates large-R, rather than averaging over single pokes that have no cascade to fuel them.
surv.sharpest_reason: Genuinely novel and causal: the prior sweep probe (_DA_sweep_reclaim_feasibility.py) used ONLY the single nearest EQL/EQH (cand[-1]) and asked binary sweep+reclaim; it never counted how many distinct levels one move removed nor detected equal-low/high shelves. Counting stacked-level/shelf clearing is a different read (liquidity-quantity / effort-vs-result analog) that mechanically targets the stop-cascade event that fuels right-tail legs — exactly the population the engine needs. surv.name: failed_continuation_trap (the sweep that traps the obvious breakout)
surv.angle: The highest-quality long sweep is one that grabs liquidity right after price made everyone SHORT — it sweeps a low that just printed a SMC bearish BOS/CHoCH (breakdown), trapping breakout-sellers, then reclaims. The trapped-side fuel is the engine of follow-through. This fuses failed_breakdown + micro_choch from the backlog into a single trapped-flow read anchored on a real SMC structural event, which neither was tested as.
surv.raw_recipe: At grab bar i (LONG): require a recent SMC bearish event (BOS-down or CHoCH-down) within last 12 closed bars whose break-price is within 0.5ATR of liq. trap_flag=1 if that breakdown is now reclaimed (close[i] > break_price). Strength = nas_short_count in last 12b that are now offside (price back above their level) — counts the trapped short signals. GOOD = trap_flag AND (recent breakdown exists) AND nas_offside>=1. Mirror SHORT (failed breakout above a swing-high/CHoCH-up, trapping longs). All SMC/NAS consumed SHIFT1.
surv.lifts_wr_how: Trapped traders must cover, providing mechanical demand — this is the single most reliable follow-through fuel. Conditioning the sweep on a freshly-failed opposite structural break should lift WR sharply versus generic sweeps because it adds a directional-fuel source that generic depth/reclaim lacks. It explicitly separates the sweep-into-trapped-supply (good) from the sweep-with-no-trapped-flow (coin-flip).

The requirement naturally throttles to a few/week and stays silent during trend-continuation chop where no break is being trapped, avoiding the streaks that came from firing on every in-trend pullback sweep.
surv.novelty: failed_breakdown and micro_choch were listed separately and never combined into a trapped-flow read keyed on NAS-offside counting + reclaim of a real SMC break price. The prior continuation test was an implementation strawman of a refuted family (per the DA verdict) and did not use trap logic at all.

surv.name: sweep_session_clock (kill-zone timing of the grab)
surv.angle: Liquidity grabs that follow through are time-clustered: gold's real stop-runs and displacement happen around London open and the NY/London overlap (the institutional kill-zones), while sweeps during the Asia/late-NY low-liquidity window are noise that mean-reverts. Time-of-grab is a pure-causal, zero-fit structural prior that has never been used as a sweep-quality gate. Refines backlog 'sweep_clock' into a concrete session band.
surv.raw_recipe: From bar timestamp t (UTC seconds, already in RAW), hour = (t//3600)%24, dow=weekday. kill_zone = 1 if hour in London-open band (07-10 UTC) or NY/London overlap (12-15 UTC). dead_zone = 1 if hour in 21-01 UTC (post-NY/Asia) or Friday after 19 UTC. GOOD sweep = kill_zone AND NOT dead_zone. Use only as a confluence gate on top of the geometric+effort sweep; fully deterministic from RAW bar time, no fit.
surv.lifts_wr_how: Restricting grabs to high-participation windows removes the thin-liquidity sweeps that revert, concentrating WR. It is a cheap orthogonal filter: it does not touch geometry or volume, it removes a whole class of structurally-doomed (low-participation) sweeps, which should push WR up by trimming the dead-zone false grabs that dilute the population.
surv.cuts_streak_how: Dead-zone sweeps come in bursts overnight when no one defends levels — exactly where back-to-back false signals accumulate. Gating them out removes that nocturnal loss cluster wholesale, directly compressing streak, and naturally throttles frequency toward 1-5/week since kill-zones are a few hours/day.
surv.novelty: Session/kill-zone timing of the SWEEP specifically (vs generic hour-as-context in group G) was never used as a gate; sweep_clock was backlog-only. Time was treated as weak context, never as a structural liquidity-participation prior on the grab itself.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: Displacement legs (the right tail) are overwhelmingly born in the kill-zones because that is when initiative volume enters; dead-zone sweeps almost never produce a multi-R leg. Conditioning on the time-of-day that produces displacement biases selection toward the window where right-tail outcomes are even possible, rather than diluting across hours where they structurally cannot occur. Being fit-free, it is also robust against the leave-one-out fragility that killed the prior thin cuts.
surv.sharpest_reason: Causal and fit-free (deterministic UTC bands, no tuned threshold), and genuinely untested as a sweep gate: the repo records hour_utc/dow but the eval passes() filter never used time, and the only prior time-probe (_DA_session_birth_pedigree) tested zone-birth volume ratio, a different mechanism. The repo's own data corroborates the premise — NY_AM (12-15 UTC) median tick-vol 5572 vs overnight 20-23h 1648-2174 — so the kill/dead-zone bands track real participation, not curve-fit. Strongest leg is streak-cut (nocturnal false-sweep clusters in 21-01 UTC are mechanically gateable and throttle frequency toward 1-5/wk; candidates are 15% dead-zone / 33% kill-zone, so a real filter not a no-op). Caveat lowering it from higher: WR-lift must be tempered because every orthogonal entry filter so far hit the same right-tail wall, and the 01h Asia tick-vol spike (4862) sits inside the proposed dead-zone band — a mild edge-tension acceptable only because it is used as confluence on top of geometric+effort sweep, not standalone.

surv.name: effort_result_divergence (ERD) — volume-absorbed reversal candle
surv.angle: Wyckoffian effort-vs-result read at the exact turn bar. Real institutional absorption = a bar that spends HUGE effort (volume) to penetrate the zone extreme but produces almost NO net result (tiny body, close rejected back). That is supply being eaten by a passive limit-buyer (demand zone) — the signature of a real absorption, not a passive touch. A passive touch is low-volume drift into the zone; an absorption is a high-volume bar that fails to extend.
surv.raw_recipe: On the just-closed bar i (final OHLCV, no repaint): rel_vol = vol[i] / median(vol[i-1..i-20]). penetration = how far low[i] (for demand) pierced past the SHIFT1 zone edge, in ATR. result = net displacement = (close[i]-low[i])/range[i] for demand (close position in upper part of its own range), and body_frac=|close-open|/range. ERD fires when rel_vol >= 2.0 AND penetration_into_zone >= 0.3*zone_width AND close_position >= 0.6 (closed in top 40% of its range, i.e. rejected the low) AND body_frac <= 0.45 (effort didn't convert to a big directional body — it was absorbed). Mirror for supply (short): close_position <= 0.4, pierced zone high. All from RAW OHLCV + ATR; zone from SHIFT1 Custom OB. Entry at close of bar i.
surv.lifts_wr_how: Separates the two cases that look IDENTICAL by location but are opposite by flow: a low-volume passive drift into the zone (no one defending → continuation through → loser) vs a high-volume bar that gets eaten and rejected (a real defender stepped in → winner). Location-only triggers (zone-touch) can't tell these apart; that is exactly why WR was stuck at 27-49%. Requiring rel_vol>=2 AND failed-result close drops the no-defender touches, which are the bulk of the losing right-tail mass.
surv.cuts_streak_how: When the market is grinding/accepting through zones (chop), ERD simply doesn't fire — accepting bars have HIGH body_frac and full-range closes (result follows effort). So the feature is structurally silent in the exact regime (acceptance/chop) that generates loss-clusters, which keeps streak short by abstention rather than by a filter.
surv.novelty: Prior tests used penetration_pct, bars_in_zone, acceptance_beyond_mid — all pure-price geometry. None combined relative-volume with the candle's OWN close-position and body-fraction as a single effort-vs-result tensor. Volume was only ever listed as 'context/confluence', never as the core discriminator paired with candle anatomy at the turn bar.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: The right-tail wall exists because entry location has no magnitude-alpha. ERD doesn't predict magnitude — it filters the SUBSTRATE: it removes the passive touches that are the modal loser, raising the base rate of 'a real defender exists here' before let-run even starts. It attacks the wall by improving the prior of the population, not by predicting the winner.
surv.sharpest_reason: Best-aimed proposal so far against the documented right-tail wall: it attacks the population PRIOR (removing no-defender passive touches to raise the base rate that a real defender exists) rather than predicting magnitude, which is exactly the failure mode the prior 4 theories hit. Strictly causal (closed bar i + trailing 20-bar window + SHIFT1 OB, entry at close — no look-ahead) and genuinely novel vs the geometry-only failed set (NAS-zone/sweep/EMA/acceptance): volume as the CORE discriminator paired with the candle's own close-position and body-fraction was never the tensor before. Wyckoff effort-vs-result absorption is a real auction/orderflow rationale, and the abstain-in-chop property gives a structurally-coherent streak cut. NOT a CUT — it is not non-causal, not redundant with the weak set, and not pure curve-fit (the hypothesis has a directional sign testable independent of the exact cutpoints). The load-bearing caveat (why score is 6.5 not 8+ and why fitting_risk=HIGH): the novel core ingredient, rel_vol>=2, rides on XAU 15M TICK-VOLUME — explicitly flagged unreliable in memory, and a prior volume×1D-bear confluence was already RETRATADO as a tick-volume artifact. Tick-vol spikes track range-expansion/volatility, so rel_vol>=2 risks selecting violent sweep-CONTINUATION (loser) and inverting the intended sign; the close_position/body_frac rejection gates only partially insulate this. Plus four jointly-tuned thresholds (2.0/0.3/0.6/0.45) over a tiny 1-5/wk firing set = large overfit surface. MANDATORY test design before any KEEP becomes a build: freeze thresholds pre-hoc and validate the EFFECT SIGN via coarse binary splits (rel_vol above/below median, close_position above/below 0.5) inside the 2 years (subwindow/jackknife/null — no OOS per the hard lock); the lift must survive coarse splits and a tick-volume-vs-range-expansion / Session-VP real-volume cross-check, not just the exact tuned cutpoints.

surv.name: bubble_cluster_polarity_collapse (BPC) — order-flow exhaustion via opposite-bubble drying
surv.angle: Market Order Bubbles encode aggressive market-order flow. A real turn isn't marked by the FIRST opposite bubble — it's marked by the EXHAUSTION of the trend-side aggressive flow followed by a polarity flip with size escalation. At a demand-zone bottom in a sweep: the SELL bubbles (plot_6/8/10) that were firing during the flush suddenly STOP, and a LARGE BUY bubble (plot_4) fires on the rejection bar. That sequence = aggressive sellers exhausted into a passive bid = absorption complete.
surv.raw_recipe: Causal SHIFT1 on bubble activations (each activation has a `time` → align to bar).
