Over a window of last K=6 closed bars: sell_flow = count/size-weighted SELL bubble activations (plot_6=1,plot_8=2,plot_10=3) per bar; buy_flow = same for BUY (plot_0/2/4). BPC-long fires when: (a) sell_flow was elevated in bars [i-6..i-2] (the flush), (b) sell_flow == 0 in the last 1-2 bars (drying), (c) a BUY bubble of size>=2 (plot_2 or plot_4) fires on bar i-1 or i. Polarity_collapse_score = (peak_sell_flow_in_window) - (sell_flow_last2) + buy_size_on_turn. Mirror for short. All from pine_shapes_bubbles per-plot activations, consumed SHIFT1.
surv.lifts_wr_how: A single opposite bubble (the basic 'cluster of bubbles in phase color' that was in the prior gestalt) is noisy — bubbles fire constantly. The DISCRIMINATOR is the derivative: trend-side flow going to zero THEN flipping. That sequence only completes when aggressive flow genuinely reverses, which is far rarer and far more predictive than any single-bar bubble. It raises WR by demanding a flow-transition, not a flow-instance.
surv.cuts_streak_how: In two-sided chop, BUY and SELL bubbles interleave continuously — sell_flow never drops to zero before a buy fires, so polarity_collapse_score stays low and BPC never triggers. The dense bidirectional bubble clusters that the visual reading flagged as noise (Ago/25, Abr-Jun/26) are structurally rejected, cutting the chop loss-clusters.
surv.novelty: Bubbles were only ever used as a binary same-bar confluence flag ('a bubble in the phase color'). The temporal SEQUENCE — trend-side bubble exhaustion → silence → opposite-size escalation — as an order-flow transition signal has never been computed. It treats the bubble stream as a flow time-series, not a marker.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: Right-tail failures came from entering on a present-tense signal (NAS/bubble) that hadn't yet been confirmed by flow reversal. BPC requires the aggressive-flow reversal to have ALREADY happened (exhaustion + flip), so it enters into a population where the auction has already changed hands — converting a coin-flip entry into a post-transfer entry.
surv.sharpest_reason: RAW-verified feasible and genuinely novel: bubble activations carry per-event time+bar_index and are dense (~61% of bars fire; plot_0..plot_10 counts 25977..957 over 3 blocks), so a windowed buy_flow/sell_flow time-series with SHIFT1 alignment is fully causal — yet no builder consumes bubbles (grep=0); FEATURE_MAP confirms they were only ever a same-bar binary confluence flag, so the temporal derivative (trend-side flow exhaustion -> silence -> opposite-size escalation) has never been computed and is orthogonal to the 4 failed triggers (NAS-zone/sweep/EMA) and the 6 geometry/volume TRAP proposals. It uses an unused order-flow channel (not the warned tick-volume) and structurally targets the engine's own right-tail/post-transfer-entry diagnosis. Real but bounded fitting risk: the 'drying' gate (sell_flow==0 over only 1-2 bars) plus K=6/size>=2/'elevated' knobs is a thin, tunable sparse trigger that could collapse to the same small-N/concentration/leave-one-out fragility that killed Theories 2-4 — so it must be built with the confirmed plot mapping re-audited (BUY=0/2/4, SELL=6/8/10, plot_10=LARGE) and validated by leave-one-out + per-window concentration, not by a single tuned cut. KEEP to build and test; do not promote on first cut.

surv.name: absorption_failure_veto (AFV) — anti-signal: effort that DID convert = no absorption
surv.angle: Inverse/veto feature, purpose-built for streak control. Most losers at zones are bars where effort DID produce result the wrong way: a high-volume bar that punched THROUGH the zone with a big body and closed beyond the far edge = initiative acceptance, the opposite of absorption. AFV is not an entry trigger — it's a hard veto that blocks any entry when the most recent zone interaction shows converted effort (no absorption occurred).
surv.raw_recipe: Causal SHIFT1 for zone, RAW for the bar. On the bars interacting with the SHIFT1 zone over last K=3: if any bar has rel_vol>=1.8 AND body_frac=|close-open|/range >= 0.7 AND close beyond the zone's far edge (for a demand zone: close < zone_low; the bar accepted through) → set absorbed=False and VETO long entries on this zone id for as long as the zone remains breached. Also veto if the zone id was 'removed' (invalidated) in RAW all_boxes. Only allow entries when no converted-effort breach is on record. Mirror for supply.
surv.lifts_wr_how: It doesn't pick winners; it removes a clean, identifiable loser class — the 'high-volume body closed through the zone' acceptance bars that the other entry features might still fire on. Removing converted-effort breaches from the eligible set raises WR by deleting a systematic loser, not by adding a predictor.
surv.cuts_streak_how: This is its primary purpose. Loss-clusters happen precisely when zones are failing one after another (a regime where every zone gets accepted through). AFV detects the first converted-effort breach and locks out that zone (and, applied across nearby zones, the regime), so the engine stops re-entering into the same failing structure — directly capping consecutive losses to streak<=5.
surv.novelty: All prior features were entry-side selectors. A volume+body 'converted-effort' detector used purely as a VETO/lockout tied to the zone life-cycle id has never been built. zone_removed existed as a flag but was never combined with the in-flight converted-effort breach as an active anti-signal.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: It doesn't try to beat the right-tail by prediction — it shrinks the loss tail of the substrate. By guaranteeing the engine never enters a zone that has already been accepted-through on volume, it removes a structurally-doomed slice of the population, improving net expectancy and streak even if no single winner is better-predicted.
surv.sharpest_reason: KEEP, but conditionally. AFV is fully causal from existing primitives: build_causal_primitives.py already parses all_boxes id->born/last_seen/REMOVED, and RAW per-bar OHLC+volume make rel_vol (vs local median, which the project canon explicitly blesses as the safe relative use of tick-volume), body_frac, and close-beyond-far-edge trivially computable SHIFT1. It is structurally justified: 'high-volume converted body that closed through the zone = initiative acceptance, the opposite of absorption' is exactly the Auction Theory loser-class FEATURE_MAP already names (penetration_pct ~75%=consumo, acceptance_beyond_mid). And it targets the CORRECT lane: the standing XAU_15M_ENGINE_REPORT + L2/BPT canon concluded entry-selection has no magnitude alpha and the only residual value is ELIMINATING bad environments to cut streak — AFV is purpose-built as a lockout veto, not a runner-selector, so it is aligned with the one live thread rather than re-hitting the right-tail wall. THE CATCH (why 6 not 8): the novelty is a recombination, not a new channel. zone_removed already exists as an invalidation flag (FEATURE_MAP section F) and TRAP_FEATURES_PROPOSALS #5 already uses the effort-vs-result/absorption lens. AFV's genuine marginal contribution is narrow: the in-flight converted-effort breach that fires BEFORE the Custom OB indicator removes the box. If a big converted-body breach usually coincides with the box being removed shortly after, AFV collapses to zone_removed and adds little. So KEEP, but the test must measure marginal streak/WR lift OVER zone_removed-alone (ablation), not AFV in isolation — otherwise its apparent edge is a relabel of an existing flag, and the 1.8/0.7/K=3 thresholds are the fit surface to watch.

surv.name: iceberg_refill_signature (IRS) — repeated absorption at one price (passive defender refilling)
surv.angle: A true institutional iceberg/limit-defender reveals itself by REPEATED absorption at the same price: multiple bars hit the same low (or a tight band), each on notable volume, each rejected, with volume not declining — the defender keeps refilling the bid. This is distinct from a single climax: it's a stand, not a spike. The micro-signature is several consecutive bars sharing a near-identical extreme with sustained volume and rejection closes.
surv.raw_recipe: Causal RAW. Over window K=4-6 closed bars at/in a SHIFT1 demand zone: count refill_bars = bars whose low is within 0.15*ATR of the window's min-low (a shared shelf) AND lower_wick_frac >= 0.35 (rejection) AND rel_vol >= 1.2 (participation). IRS-long fires when refill_bars >= 3 AND the window's net price change is ~flat (|close[i]-close[i-K]| <= 0.5*ATR, i.e. price held the shelf despite the effort) AND the latest bar closes above the shelf. refill_strength = sum(rel_vol over refill_bars). Mirror (shared high) for supply. All RAW OHLCV+volume+ATR.
surv.lifts_wr_how: Single-touch entries (every basic trigger) can't see persistence. IRS requires the level to be defended REPEATEDLY with sustained volume — the strongest available evidence that a real passive size sits there. Multi-bar refilled shelves hold far more often than first-touch levels, so conditioning on >=3 refills sharply raises the hold-rate (WR) of the entered set.
surv.cuts_streak_how: A level that's about to fail shows DECLINING lows (no shared shelf) or declining volume (no refill) — IRS's shared-shelf + sustained-volume gates both fail, so it abstains. It only fires on genuinely-held shelves, structurally skipping the sliding-lows sequences that produce consecutive stops.
surv.novelty: zone_mitig_count counted touches but treated retests as NEGATIVE (more touches = weaker). IRS reframes: touches that HOLD the same price WITH sustained volume are POSITIVE (refilling defender), the opposite reading, and couples count with a flat-price + sustained-volume condition never tested. The 'refill' (volume not declining across touches) dimension is entirely new.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: The wall is that most levels are undefended and fail. IRS only admits levels with multi-bar proof of a passive defender — a small, high-quality slice of the population with a structurally higher hold-rate. It beats the right-tail by drastically purifying the entered set (fewer, better-defended levels) rather than predicting the magnitude of the ensuing run.
surv.sharpest_reason: Causal and structurally sound, and the core idea is genuinely novel vs the 4 failed theories: it INVERTS the polarity of the existing zone_mitig_count feature (which treated more touches as weaker/loser) into a "refilled-shelf = defended" positive read, coupling count with flat-price + non-declining-volume — a dimension never tested. That earns a KEEP. BUT the load-bearing discriminator over plain zone-touch is the volume-refill condition (rel_vol>=1.2 hard gate + refill_strength sum), and volume on this feed is TICK-VOLUME, flagged repeatedly in project memory as unreliable (use Session VP). The prior backlog absorption item deliberately used volume only relatively/within-leg to dodge this; IRS leans harder on an absolute volume threshold, exposing its claimed edge to the weakest channel. With ~6 tunable knobs over a 2yr sample whose good slice is ~5% and concentrated, fit risk is high. It also overlaps the untested backlog #5 ABSORPTION_AT_EXTREME (multi-bar variant of the same effort/absorption thesis). Recommended path: test geometry-only first (shared shelf + flat hold + reclaim, NO volume gate) to confirm the persistence geometry lifts WR on RAW OHLC, then add volume-refill only if geometry survives — otherwise the novelty fits on tick-volume noise.

surv.name: squeeze_release_retest (SRR)
surv.angle: Don't fade or chase the breakout — wait for ATR/range compression to plateau, let it BREAK (displacement bar), then enter on the FIRST pullback that retests the broken compression box. The squeeze stores potential energy; the retest confirms the release is initiative (not a wick) and gives a tight structural SL inside the old coil.
surv.raw_recipe: Causal per-bar from primitives series (SHIFT1 on decision). 1) compression state at bar i-1: rng[j]=h-l; require 4+ consecutive bars with rng<0.7*atr (sub-0.7ATR squeeze plateau, base rate ~6-9% confirmed across 8 blocks). Record coil_hi=max(h), coil_lo=min(l) of the plateau. 2) RELEASE: a bar k closes beyond the coil with rng[k]>1.5*atr[k-1] and |c-o|/rng[k]>0.6 (body-dominant displacement, not wick). dir = sign(c-o). 3) ENTRY ARMED on a LATER bar m (m within 8 bars of k) where price pulls back to within 0.25*atr of the broken coil edge (coil_hi for longs / coil_lo for shorts) but does NOT close back inside the coil (close still beyond edge). Entry = close of m. SL = far side of coil +/- 0.3*atr. Direction must match macro_4h phase and zone polarity (reuse existing gate). All metrics use only bars<=m.
surv.lifts_wr_how: Two stacked filters that basic triggers lack: (a) the body-dominant displacement requirement kills the wick/liquidity-grab false releases that produce immediate whipsaw stops; (b) entering on the retest (not the thrust) removes the MAE-chase the inline probe exposed (thrust-entry medMAE 3.96ATR > baseline 3.08 — buying the spike LOSES). The retest both lowers entry MAE (you buy the pullback) and confirms the level now holds as support/resistance, which is the empirical signature of a real auction shift — separating the ~15% that run from the chop.
surv.cuts_streak_how: The 4-bar coil precondition is a hard environmental gate: it can only arm when the market was genuinely quiet, so it structurally cannot fire during the dense bidirectional TOP+BOTTOM chop the visual prints flag as the loss-cluster zone (chop has no sub-0.7ATR plateau — range is already elevated and noisy). No coil => no trade => the streak-generating chop periods are skipped by construction.
surv.novelty: Every tested trigger (NAS-in-zone, sweep+reclaim, EMA-pullback) fires on a PRICE-LOCATION state and ignores the volatility regime that birthed it. SRR conditions on the volatility TRANSITION itself (compression->expansion) and uses the coil as the SL reference rather than ATR-fixed. The displacement-body + retest-of-coil combination was never built; prior sweep+reclaim used swing-low geometry, not the compression box.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: The right tail IS the post-compression expansion legs — that's literally where the ~5% of magnitude lives. Basic triggers sample the whole distribution including the dead-money middle; SRR mechanically OVER-samples the ignition points of expansions and STARVES the plateau/chop. By only taking the retest of a genuine release, it harvests the fat tail's birth moment instead of entering randomly across the regime, which is the one structural reason to expect a different MFE distribution than the three triggers that hit the wall.
surv.sharpest_reason: SRR is causal and structurally honest, and its genuinely new content is narrow but real: it conditions on the volatility TRANSITION (compression to expansion) rather than price-location (NAS-in-zone/sweep/EMA all do the latter), and enters on the RETEST of the broken coil with a coil-anchored SL — an entry-timing axis the right-tail-wall diagnosis never directly tested. The streak-cut mechanism is its strongest claim and is independently valuable: the 4-bar sub-0.7ATR coil precondition structurally cannot fire during elevated-range bidirectional chop (squeeze3 base rate only ~6-9%, and chop has no plateau), so it skips the loss-cluster environment by construction — the same convergence/elimination logic that cut streaks at L2/BPT 4H. KEEP, but rank BELOW the TRAP stack and treat WR-lift as unproven, because (1) the repo already showed displacement MAGNITUDE does NOT pick runners (0.45 vs 0.46 ATR) and thrust-entry chases MAE — SRR's body-dominant/displacement pillar leans on an axis shown weak; (2) after stacking 7 thresholds and gating on macro+zone polarity onto a ~6-9% coil base rate, the armed sample will be thin, which is the exact regime where every prior cut collapsed into small-N / single-window / leave-one-out artifact. Validate as a streak-CUT environmental gate first (high plausibility) and only secondarily as a WR lift (medium, partly pre-refuted).

surv.name: coil_break_failure_skip (CBFS) — a SKIP feature
surv.angle: A pure environment-quality DETECTOR, not an entry trigger: count how often recent compression breakouts FAILED (broke the coil then closed back inside within N bars). High failure rate = the market is in a mean-reverting / liquidity-vacuum regime where breakouts get sold — VETO all long-continuation entries until the failure rate decays. This directly targets cut-streak by reading ambient breakout-reliability.
surv.raw_recipe: Per-bar causal, trailing only. Over a rolling window of the last 120 bars (~30h), detect every micro-coil-break: a bar that closes beyond a local 10-bar range extreme by >1.0*atr. Tag it FAILED if within the next 6 bars price closes back inside that 10-bar range. coil_fail_rate = failed_breaks / total_breaks over the window (only counting breaks whose 6-bar resolution is fully in the past => no look-ahead). SKIP gate: if coil_fail_rate > 0.6 (breakouts mostly failing => choppy/distributive regime), block all new entries this bar. Also expose breakout_reliability = 1 - fail_rate as a continuous confluence score.
surv.lifts_wr_how: Indirectly but powerfully: by suppressing entries during regimes where the market demonstrably punishes directional commitment, the surviving entries occur only when breakouts have been holding (reliability>0.4). Conditioning entries on a regime that has been REWARDING follow-through raises the base rate that any given continuation entry reaches its target — it filters the population to the half of the distribution where momentum persists.
surv.cuts_streak_how: This is its primary purpose. Loss clusters happen when the same regime keeps whipsawing the same setup. coil_fail_rate is a direct, causal thermometer of that regime: when it's high the gate is CLOSED, so the consecutive losses that define a streak literally cannot be entered. It turns 'I kept getting stopped' into a measured, blockable state. Because it's computed on already-resolved breaks, it lags reality by ~6 bars but that lag is conservative (it stays cautious slightly too long, never too short).
surv.novelty: chop_score is in the backlog but as a generic density metric. CBFS is fundamentally different: it measures ENVIRONMENTAL BREAKOUT RELIABILITY by auditing the fate of recent breakouts — a self-referential, outcome-grounded regime read that no tested feature uses. It's the market grading its own follow-through, computed entirely causally.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: It doesn't try to find better entries — it removes the regime where the right-tail is structurally absent. In mean-reverting/distributive regimes the expansion legs simply don't form (breakouts fail), so the right tail is empty and every entry is dead-money. By vetoing those windows, the remaining sample is drawn only from periods where directional legs DO form, raising the conditional probability that a let-run trade catches the tail. It attacks the wall by deleting the half of the data that has no tail to catch.
surv.sharpest_reason: CBFS is a regime-ELIMINATION/SKIP detector, not another entry trigger — which is precisely the only mechanism the corpus has shown to actually work. The central wall here (XAU_15M_ENGINE_REPORT.md L20-23) and the L2/BPT 4H canon both conclude entry-selection has no magnitude alpha and that edge lives in regime/risk-shaping; the TRAP_FEATURES cross-cutting note (L143-145) already endorses 'convergence ELIMINATES bad environments (cut streak)' as the validated pattern. CBFS instantiates exactly that pattern with a causally-sound, lag-conservative thermometer (only past-resolved 6-bar breaks → no look-ahead), and is genuinely distinct from the three failed triggers (NAS-zona/sweep/EMA) AND from backlog chop_score (density), because it audits the OUTCOME/fate of recent breakouts rather than bar geometry — a self-referential reliability read no tested feature uses. Under the RELAXED meta (Cris 2026-06-26: streak≤5 now the primary soft target, no DD floor), a direct streak-cut regime gate is aimed at the highest-value objective. CUT was not warranted: it is causal, non-redundant with the failed-weak set, and has real structural rationale. The honest risk is parameter-fitting (the 0.6 fail-rate cutoff + 1.0*atr/6-bar/120-bar windows are free knobs that invite tuning) and the WR-lift claim is only indirect (population-shift, not entry-quality) per the auction-irreducible-loser finding — so validate the cutoff by jackknife/sub-window/leave-one-block-out and null-permutation INSIDE the 8 blocks (never fit the threshold), report it as an elimination gate not a WR-selector, and pair it as a conv-stack member rather than a standalone isolated gate.

surv.name: time_of_day_volatility_window (TDVW)
surv.angle: Volatility transitions in XAU are not uniform across the clock — the London open and NY open/overlap are the structural ignition windows where compressed Asian ranges release into trend, while late-NY and Asian sessions are mean-reverting drift. Gate expansion-onset entries to the session windows where the squeeze->expansion transition actually carries follow-through, and veto it elsewhere.
surv.raw_recipe: Per-bar causal — hour_utc and dow are already in the feature set (bar time, zero look-ahead). Define session_quality: bin bars by hour_utc. Compute, on a TRAILING basis over the prior K days only, the realized post-bar expansion follow-through per hour-bin (e.g., median forward 20-bar |displacement|/atr for bars in each hour, using only fully-resolved past bars). Mark hours whose trailing follow-through is in the top tercile as ACTIVE windows. ENTRY gate: a squeeze-release / NAS-zone confluence is only allowed when hour_utc is in the current ACTIVE set AND not within the first 2 bars of a known rollover/illiquid gap. Combine multiplicatively with SRR/VRPF. The hour-quality table is rebuilt rolling so it adapts causally.
surv.lifts_wr_how: Removes entries taken in the dead Asian/late-NY hours where compression releases are typically false (no institutional flow to sustain them) and concentrates them in London/NY ignition windows where releases trend. Same trigger, but conditioned on the time-of-day when follow-through is structurally present — this lifts the fraction of entries that reach 2:1 because the macro liquidity backdrop supports continuation rather than fading it.
surv.cuts_streak_how: A large share of XAU 15M chop is session-bound (Asian range, lunch lulls). Hard-gating those hours out eliminates a whole class of repetitive-loss environments at once. Because losing streaks often accumulate within a single dead session as the same setup fails repeatedly, removing those hours mechanically severs that cluster source.
surv.novelty: Hour/session was listed as 'secondary context, not a gate' in the feature map and never elevated to an ACTIVE-window gate tied to realized volatility-transition follow-through. Using a TRAILING per-hour follow-through table (the market teaching you which hours release cleanly) as a hard entry filter, fused with the squeeze lens, is unexplored — prior work treated time as a weak confluence at most.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: The right-tail expansion legs in gold cluster in specific liquidity windows; entering blind to the clock dilutes those tails with dead-session noise that has no tail at all. By restricting to the hours where the volatility-transition historically produces displacement, TDVW raises the prior probability that any given squeeze-release is one of the tail-producing London/NY ignitions rather than a fizzled Asian-range poke — sampling the part of the day where the fat tail lives.
surv.sharpest_reason: Causally clean (entry-bar hour known at close; trailing follow-through table uses only resolved past bars — distinct from the codebase's DA#3 j+1-outcome-fit prohibition) and genuinely novel: time was 'secondary context, not a gate' in FEATURE_MAP and is absent from the backlog, so it is NOT redundant with the three tested-weak triggers (NAS-zone/sweep/EMA). The Asian-compression -> London/NY-ignition rationale is real microstructure and the streak-cut mechanism (severing whole session-bound chop clusters at once) directly targets the engine's documented streak problem rather than the unbeatable entry-magnitude wall — which is why it survives. BUT fitting_risk is high and decisive: the engine's wall is a right-tail substrate where every quality cut is 'raro + 1 janela + não robusto leave-one-out', and the only marginal survivor (partial2R) was already concentrated in Aug-Nov 2024 — a trailing top-tercile hour table (K-days, tercile cut, bin granularity, ACTIVE-set as free knobs) will very likely re-discover that same concentration window and dress it as edge (circularity). KEEP, but ONLY as a streak/risk-shaping gate validated as a FIXED London/NY block first (no adaptive trailing tercile), gated on leave-one-block-out, not as a WR-alpha claim — the entry trigger still carries no magnitude alpha.

surv.name: sweep_then_choch_then_initiative_FSM
surv.angle: Causal finite-state machine over the canonical institutional reversal grammar: liquidity is taken BEFORE structure flips BEFORE order-flow confirms. The ORDER and inter-step latency carry the edge, not co-presence. A true reversal must traverse states S0(swept a prior 15M swing-low/high into a live OB zone) -> S1(micro-CHoCH on the SMC stream in the new direction, i.e. first counter-swing break) -> S2(initiative bubble = BUY/SELL Market-Order bubble of size>=median printed AFTER the CHoCH) -> S3(NAS first-appearance confirms, entry on its close). Each transition must occur within a bounded bar-window of the previous and must not regress (no opposite-side sweep or opposite CHoCH in between, which resets to S0).
surv.raw_recipe: All streams SHIFT1 / as-of close. Build a per-bar walker over primitives.series with side-streams smc_events and OB-zone-id and bubble plots. (1) S0 swept: low[i] < min(swing_low over last L=8..20 bars) AND close[i] back above that swing_low (reclaim same/next bar) AND bar is inside a live DEMAND zone id (long case; mirror for SHORT/SUPPLY). Record t0, zone_id. (2) S1 micro_choch: first SMC BOS/CHoCH event with derived swing direction = setup direction occurring at bar t1 with 1<=t1-t0<=W1 (W1=6 bars) and no opposite-direction swing-break between. (3) S2 initiative: a BUY bubble (plot mapped BUY=plot_0/2/4) with size>=block-median bubble size firing at t2, 0<=t2-t1<=W2 (W2=4). (4) S3 nas: NAS LONG first-appearance at t3, 0<=t3-t2<=W3 (W3=4), inside same zone_id still alive. Entry=close(t3+1). Emit boolean fsm_complete + ordinal latency vector (t1-t0,t2-t1,t3-t2) + reset_count (how many times sequence regressed before completing). Any opposite sweep/CHoCH between steps forces reset to S0 and is logged.
surv.lifts_wr_how: The 791-candidate universe is NAS-in-zone presence only; ~5% carry the tail. This FSM keeps ONLY candidates whose causal genealogy is liquidity-grab -> structure-flip -> initiative -> signal in that exact order. That genealogy is the structural definition of a real auction reversal vs an absorption (loser), which in the static tests was indistinguishable because all four ingredients can be present in any order in a chop. Ordering filters absorption: in absorption the NAS/zone touch precedes any CHoCH and no initiative bubble fires before the signal. Expected to lift WR by excluding the order-violating majority that dilutes the universe to 27-49%.
surv.cuts_streak_how: reset_count and a 'no S1 within W1' early-exit make the FSM emit nothing during chop/contra-phase (where sweeps happen but never produce a CHoCH+initiative chain), structurally suppressing the loss-clusters that drive streak. A loss-cluster is a regime where sweeps keep failing to flip structure; the FSM stays in S0/S1 and fires zero trades through it.
surv.novelty: Every prior test fed sweep_reclaim, micro_choch, NAS and bubbles as SIMULTANEOUS presence flags (FEATURE_MAP B/C/D, backlog). None encoded transition ORDER, bounded inter-step latency, or a regression/reset rule. This is the first causal state-machine over the grammar rather than a bag-of-features.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: The right-tail wall came from selecting on magnitude-blind presence. Ordered genealogy is a different axis: it does not predict magnitude, it predicts whether the move is initiative-driven (which is what produces the rare long runs that hold the tail). By requiring initiative (bubble) to APPEAR AFTER the structural flip, it conditions specifically on the displacement that creates right-tail outcomes, instead of averaging over absorptions that produce the median-stop.
surv.sharpest_reason: KEEP, but guarded. The WR-lift thesis is the single genuinely-novel and structurally-real mechanism that attacks the exact wall the prior 4 theories hit: the static tests fed sweep/CHoCH/NAS/bubble as SIMULTANEOUS presence flags (FEATURE_MAP B/C/D), so initiative-driven reversals and absorptions were literally indistinguishable because all four can co-occur in any order in chop. Encoding ORDER + bounded inter-step latency + a regression/reset rule is a real new axis (ordered genealogy = the structural definition of an auction reversal), not a relabel of the tested-weak primitives, so it earns a look under the ALIVED meta (WR 40-50, streak<=5, no DD floor). BUT three hard caveats drag the score to 6: (1) FATAL-substrate risk — the sparsity diagnostics already on disk show EQH=402/EQL=315 over 2yr/8 blocks and sweep+reclaim of opposite EQ is rare per _DA_sweep_reclaim_feasibility; the FSM is a CONJUNCTIVE cascade (S0∧S1∧S2∧S3) under tight windows (W1=6,W2=4,W3=4) AND same-live-zone-id, each conjunct multiplying sparsity — expected fire count lands squarely in the small-N artifact zone that killed Theory 2 (n17, 2 trades=83%, leave-out −9), likely undershooting even the 1/wk floor. (2) The streak-cut claim is the weak limb and near-circular: "fires zero through chop" is achieved trivially by extreme sparsity, not by genuine environment-detection — a feature that almost never fires has no loss-clusters because it has almost no trades. (3) FEASIBILITY GAP — S2 (initiative bubble size>=median AFTER CHoCH) is NOT in the built primitives (top-level keys lack any bubble field; MANIFEST classifies bubbles as 'secundário/contexto', un-serialized), so it needs re-extraction, and bubble plot-size mapping is a documented recurring error source in memory. Conditions to test: (a) re-extract+validate bubble plots vs the plot-mapping memory before trusting S2; (b) test the ORDINAL-LATENCY VECTOR as a SOFT quality score / convergence-count over the broader sweep universe, NOT only as a hard 4-state gate, to escape the conjunctive sparsity death; (c) gate on validation inside the 8 blocks (leave-one-block-out + null permutation) since any n<~25 fire-count is presumed artifact. CUT it the moment fire-count proves it is just the sparsity producing a fake high-WR handful.

surv.name: latency_decay_conviction_score
surv.angle: In a high-conviction auction, the confluence ingredients arrive FAST and TIGHT; in a low-conviction grind they trickle in stretched out or out of order. Treat the inter-event latencies of the ordered chain (sweep->choch->bubble->nas) as a continuous conviction signal: shorter total span and monotonic ordering = institutional urgency; long, gappy spans = drift. This converts the binary FSM into a graded score so the threshold can be calibrated to the 1-5/week budget.
surv.raw_recipe: On every fsm_complete candidate from the FSM walker, compute span_bars=t3-t0, gap_max=max(t1-t0,t2-t1,t3-t2), order_purity=1 if strictly non-regressing else penalize by reset_count. conviction = exp(-span_bars/tau) * (1/(1+gap_max)) * order_purity, tau calibrated per block by median span (not by outcome — calibration only). Also fold arrival_velocity_atr (already in primitives: displacement N bars pre-zone /ATR) as a multiplier: high arrival velocity INTO the sweep then deceleration into reclaim = spring-load. All inputs causal/SHIFT1, computed from series timestamps only.
surv.lifts_wr_how: Ranks the ordered candidates and keeps the top conviction decile to hit 1-5/week. The hypothesis: WR is monotonic in conviction because tight-fast-ordered chains are the institutional grabs, while stretched chains are coincidental co-occurrence. This gives a tunable knob to trade WR for frequency along a structurally-motivated axis instead of an outcome-fitted one.
surv.cuts_streak_how: Loss-clusters live in low-conviction regimes (stretched, gappy chains). A conviction floor drops every candidate during those regimes, so consecutive losers cannot accumulate — the engine simply abstains when urgency is absent.
surv.novelty: Latency between ordered confluence events has never been measured here; prior features used counts (nas_count_in_zone), spans of a single stream (nas_cluster_span_bars), or static distances — never the cross-stream temporal compression of the full ordered chain as a conviction proxy.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: Temporal compression of initiative is a leading correlate of displacement magnitude (urgent fills precede impulsive legs). By scoring on cross-stream urgency, it preferentially selects the impulsive-leg precursors that populate the right tail, rather than the slow absorptions that define the median-stop body — directly targeting the 5% where expectancy lives.
surv.sharpest_reason: Causal and genuinely novel (cross-stream inter-event latency of an ordered chain has never been computed here; prior work used counts and single-stream spans only — all inputs are confirmed-event timestamps, SHIFT1-safe, and arrival_velocity_atr already exists as a primitive). KEEP, but heavily caveated and on the streak-cut/elimination axis, NOT the WR-lift axis. Three problems pull the score down: (1) the bubble link of the sweep->choch->bubble->nas chain is NOT serialized in the per-bar primitives (only nas_events/smc_events/zones/series exist; bubbles are tagged 'secundário/contexto' via pine_shapes activations) — the chain degrades to sweep->choch->nas, weakening the 'full ordered chain' premise. (2) The WR-lift mechanism ('conviction is monotonic in displacement magnitude') is the EXACT claim the engine already refuted: XAU_15M_ENGINE_REPORT documents that entry-selection produces a right-tail substrate where 3 orthogonal triggers hit the same wall, magnitude has no entry-alpha, and every meta-quality cut was rare + few-trades-driven + failed leave-one-out. Ranking fsm_complete candidates and keeping the top conviction decile is precisely that rare-concentrated-thin-slice recipe — high overfit risk, plus 'tau calibrated per block by median span' on the same 8 evaluation blocks is the calibration-as-validation red flag memory bans. (3) Its defensible use is the inverse of what it claims: as a graded conviction FLOOR that abstains in low-urgency/gappy regimes (drop every candidate when urgency is absent) it plausibly CUTS streak via environment elimination — consistent with the L2/BPT and cross-cutting finding that convergence eliminates bad environments without selecting the runner. Test it as an elimination gate (conviction floor → abstain) with leave-one-block-out and null-permutation, NOT as a runner-selecting top-decile rank; expect the WR-lift to evaporate but the streak/abstention behavior to survive.

surv.name: failed_choch_reclaim_trap_FSM
surv.angle: The highest-conviction continuation entries come from a SHALLOW FAILURE: price attempts a structure break AGAINST the intended direction, that break FAILS (no follow-through / gets reclaimed), and only THEN the original direction reasserts. This 'fakeout-then-go' sequence traps counter-traders and provides the fuel. Order: micro-CHoCH against -> failed (reclaim of broken level within K bars, no second confirmation) -> CHoCH/BOS with -> NAS+zone. It is the inverse-order cousin of the reversal FSM and specifically catches continuation, the sub-population (n=42) that static tests under-served.
surv.raw_recipe: SHIFT1 walker. (1) detect counter-CHoCH: SMC swing-break opposite to macro/leg_dir at t0. (2) failed: the broken swing level is reclaimed by close within K=5 bars AND no second same-direction (counter) break occurs in that window. (3) reassert: BOS/CHoCH in leg_dir direction at t1>failed_t within W=8 bars. (4) confirm: NAS first-appearance dir=leg_dir inside a live matching OB zone at t2, 0<=t2-t1<=4. Entry close(t2+1). Use leg_dir / macro_swing_dir already in candidates_features.csv. Emit trap_depth_atr = how far the failed break exceeded the level (brk_exc_atr already computed) and reclaim_speed.
surv.lifts_wr_how: Separates real continuation (trap-fueled) from naive pullback-EMA (already refuted). The failed-break-then-reclaim is a structural liquidity event that the bare pullback lacked; it conditions on counter-traders being stopped, which historically precedes the cleaner continuation runs. Should lift WR on the continuation side specifically, which the report flagged as a thin, under-explored sub-population.
surv.cuts_streak_how: Requires a FAILED counter-break — in genuinely reversing/choppy regimes the counter-break does NOT fail (it follows through), so the FSM emits nothing, abstaining exactly in the environments where continuation entries get chopped. This is regime-detection by construction.
surv.novelty: Continuation was tested only as pullback-EMA / setup_vs_flow=continuation static flags. Nobody encoded the failed-counter-break-then-reassert ORDER, which is a distinct micro-structural trap pattern (failed_breakdown existed in backlog but only as a static one-step flag, never as the 3-step trap-then-go sequence).
surv.beats_right_tail_how: Trap-and-reverse continuations are textbook right-tail generators: the stopped counter-traders' liquidation adds momentum to the existing leg, producing the multi-bar runs that hold the tail. Plain pullbacks lacked this fuel and stayed in the median-stop body; conditioning on the failed break targets the fueled continuations directly.
surv.sharpest_reason: Causally clean and genuinely novel: the ordered 3-step counter-CHoCH -> failed-reclaim -> reassert sequence is a distinct FSM lens never tested (prior continuation work was only static pullback-EMA or one-step failed_breakdown flags), and all stages are computable SHIFT1 from already-serialized RAW SMC BOS/CHoCH first-appearance labels + brk_exc_atr + leg_dir. The trap-fuel rationale (liquidated counter-traders supplying the resumed leg) is textbook-sound and the abstention-by-construction in genuine reversals is a legitimate streak-cut mechanism aligned with the prior L2/BPT convergence-eliminates-bad-environments finding. BUT it explicitly targets the report-confirmed THIN continuation sub-population (n=42/791 ~5%), and a 4-way AND-gate with four tunable windows (K=5,W=8,t2-t1<=4 plus NAS+zone) over that rare base will fire in low single digits per block, so any WR/streak estimate rests on a tiny n -> high overfit/noise risk and re-imports the already-weak NAS-in-zone gate at stage 4. KEEP under the aliviada investigative meta, but pre-register a fire-count floor: if total fires across the 8 blocks are below ~8-10, treat as uninterpretable noise, not a win, and validate strictly as a sequence with per-block/jackknife/null-permutation.

surv.name: zone_handoff_relay_sequence
surv.angle: Read the SEQUENCE across two stacked OB zones (a multi-timeframe / multi-level nest) as a relay: price rejects an inner 15M zone, then a SECOND deeper/aligned zone (lower-TF resample or an older OB id) confirms by also being defended in the SAME direction shortly after. The ordered hand-off between two zones being defended in sequence is far stronger than a single zone touch. Targets the mtf_value_nest backlog item but as an ordered relay, not co-location.
surv.raw_recipe: SHIFT1. Maintain all live OB-zone ids (from all_boxes id lifecycle) plus 4H-resample zone boundaries. (1) zone A (15M) defended: penetration_pct<=0.5 + reclaim at t0, zone_id_A. (2) within W=10 bars, a SECOND distinct live zone B (either a 4H-resample demand band, or an older nested 15M demand id below A) is touched and defended (close reclaims its edge) in the SAME direction at t1>t0 — i.e. the value nest holds at two levels in sequence. (3) NAS first-appearance dir-matched at t2 inside A or B, t2-t1<=4. Entry close(t2+1). Emit nest_depth (number of stacked defended zones), handoff_gap=t1-t0. All zone geometry from RAW all_boxes; 4H from resample of series.
surv.lifts_wr_how: A single defended zone is the 791-universe baseline (WR diluted). Two zones defended IN SEQUENCE means the value area is being respected at multiple scales — a much rarer, higher-conviction acceptance-of-value-then-rejection-of-lower. This raises WR by demanding multi-level structural agreement that absorptions (single-zone consume) cannot fake.
surv.cuts_streak_how: During distribution/markdown, lower zones are NOT defended (they break in sequence rather than hold) so the relay never completes; the engine abstains through the exact regimes that produce stop-clusters.
surv.novelty: mtf_value_nest was a static co-location flag (price near several zones at once). The ordered relay — zone A defended THEN zone B defended within a window in the same direction — is a temporal hand-off never tested; it uses zone lifecycle ids as sequence anchors, not just presence.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: Multi-scale defended value is where the largest reversals originate (institutions defend a value nest before the re-auction to the opposite extreme = let-run target). Single-zone touches sat in the median body; the relay conditions on the multi-scale base that precedes the full re-auction legs holding the right tail.
surv.sharpest_reason: Causal and structurally coherent, and the genuinely novel angle is TEMPORAL: an ordered two-zone hand-off (relay) vs the static co-location of mtf_value_nest — that sequence is untested. Its best survival is as an ABSTENTION/environment detector (relay fails to complete during markdown because lower zones break instead of hold), which mechanically matches the documented streak-cut win pattern (conv<=1 eliminates bad regimes without cutting runners). BUT three concerns cap it: (1) every ATOMIC ingredient (penetration+reclaim, NAS-in-zone, acceptance) is already in the weak-isolated set — the bet rides entirely on the ordering adding edge the parts lack; (2) HIGH fit risk — W=10, handoff_gap, t2-t1<=4, penetration<=0.5, plus undefined 'nested id below A' and 4H-band selection are many knobs over a documented right-tail substrate where stacking conditions collapses N and convergence>=3 historically reverts to base rate (selects rarity, not edge); (3) the core premise 'two defended static zones = stronger' collides with the 2026-06-23 finding that static WALL/value geometry is pre-impulse in bull and WALL->fade was REFUTED/quarantined, and the over-fade-irreducible-at-entry result that no runner-vs-stop separator exists in entry geometry. KEEP only as a streak-cut/abstention signal with fit-risk flagged, NOT as a WR-selector; test the sequence purely as an environment gate, not a co-location stack.

surv.name: rsi_regime_phase_gate_on_chain
surv.angle: Use the RSI trajectory SHAPE (not level) as a sequential phase-gate stacked on the confluence chain: a high-conviction reversal shows RSI making a momentum divergence / failure-swing in the bars LEADING INTO the sweep, then a sharp regime-shift cross coincident with the CHoCH. The ordered pairing of RSI-divergence-before-sweep then RSI-thrust-at-flip is a microstructure-of-momentum confirmation the static rsi-level feature (bimodal q1 32/q3 69) completely missed.
surv.raw_recipe: SHIFT1, RSI from study_values series. (1) pre-sweep divergence: over lookback 8-14 bars price makes a lower-low (long case) while RSI makes a higher-low at the sweep bar t0 (failure swing). (2) at CHoCH bar t1 (from the reversal FSM), RSI crosses its own N=5 SMA from below AND rises >X points in <=2 bars (momentum thrust). (3) chain proceeds (bubble/NAS) as in FSM. Gate = both RSI conditions true in order. Emit div_strength (RSI-slope minus price-slope) and thrust_delta. Pure RSI series math, causal.
surv.lifts_wr_how: RSI divergence-then-thrust in sequence with structure is a classic exhaustion-then-initiation signature. The static RSI level was non-discriminating because level alone doesn't say whether momentum is turning; the ordered shape (divergence INTO the sweep, thrust AT the flip) does. Gating the chain on it removes the candidates where price reverses on structure but momentum is still falling (failure-to-follow = loser), lifting WR.
surv.cuts_streak_how: In trending-against / chop regimes RSI shows continuation (no divergence, no thrust at the structure level), so the gate stays shut, abstaining through loss-clusters where momentum never confirms the structural flip.
surv.novelty: RSI was used only as a static level/bimodal context (FEATURE_MAP G). RSI trajectory shape (failure-swing divergence) ORDERED relative to the sweep and a momentum-thrust ORDERED relative to the CHoCH has never been computed — it is a sequential momentum-microstructure gate, not a level filter.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: Momentum thrust at the structural flip is a direct precursor of impulsive displacement (the right-tail legs). Static RSI level captured none of the timing; conditioning on divergence-then-thrust selects the momentum-ignition candidates that produce the runs, rather than the momentum-fading reversals that stall at the median stop.
surv.sharpest_reason: Causal (RSI is non-repainting math on closed bars; FEATURE_MAP confirms RSI(14)[i] OK, and sweep/CHoCH come from the already-SHIFT1'd reversal FSM) and genuinely novel: RSI was only tested as a STATIC bimodal level (REPORT_STAGEB q1 32 / q3 69), never as trajectory SHAPE (failure-swing divergence) ORDERED into the sweep + thrust ORDERED at the CHoCH. It is a gate STACKED on the confluence chain, not a re-run of the three already-fraco isolated triggers (NAS-em-zona / sweep+reclaim / EMA-pullback), and it attacks a different axis — momentum-follow-through vs failure-to-follow — which is precisely where the right-tail substrate's losers live (reversal-on-structure-with-momentum-still-falling = stall at median stop). KEEP, but with explicit reservations, NOT a high score: (1) high fit risk — the recipe has 4+ free knobs (lookback 8-14, N=5 SMA, thrust X-points, ≤2 bars) over a thin right-tail base where every prior entry-side recorte was poucos-trades / single-window / leave-one-out-fragile; (2) classic RSI divergence is notoriously weak/late on fast 15M reversals, and the bimodal-RSI-being-non-discriminating prior is faint evidence RSI carries usable timing info here; (3) WR-lift plausibility is low (the canon is that entry-selection has no magnitude alpha and all triggers hit the same wall), but streak-cut plausibility is medium because as an ABSTENTION gate (shut when no divergence/thrust confirms the flip) it matches the cut-bad-environment goal better than the lift-WR goal. Worth exactly one disciplined, pre-registered test (frozen params, leave-one-out, lift-per-episode, no threshold tuning on the same set), not a CUT — but bound the parameter freedom hard or it becomes curve-fit on the thin substrate.

surv.name: anti_sequence_veto_environment_detector
surv.angle: Instead of selecting good entries, run a parallel state-machine that DETECTS the loss-cluster environment and vetoes ALL entries through it — a pure streak-cutter. The signature of a bad environment is a recurring ANTI-ordered pattern: sweeps that get swept again (failed reclaims stacking), CHoCHs that immediately reverse (whipsaw), and bubbles firing both sides in close succession (two-sided initiative = no winner). When this anti-sequence is active, abstain regardless of any chain completing.
surv.raw_recipe: SHIFT1 rolling detector over last M=30 bars. Count: (a) failed_reclaims = sweeps where close did NOT reclaim within 3 bars; (b) whipsaw_choch = pairs of opposite SMC swing-breaks within <=4 bars of each other; (c) two_sided_bubble = BUY and SELL bubbles both firing within <=3 bars. env_bad = (a>=2) OR (whipsaw_choch>=2) OR (two_sided_bubble>=2) in the window. Veto any entry whose t falls inside an env_bad window. Emit env_score continuous = weighted sum, and a hysteresis (must see 5 clean bars to clear the veto). All from series + smc_events + bubble plots, causal.
surv.lifts_wr_how: It does not pick winners; it removes the structurally-noisy regime where ALL entry types historically degrade (the report's chop/contra-phase 'noise'). Removing the worst environment mechanically raises realized WR of whatever entry runs alongside it, because the diluting losers are concentrated in env_bad windows.
surv.cuts_streak_how: This is the explicit streak-cutter: loss-clusters BY DEFINITION occur in whipsaw/two-sided-initiative regimes. Detecting that signature and vetoing through it (with hysteresis so it doesn't re-enable mid-cluster) directly caps consecutive losers — the streak<=5 target is addressed at the environment level rather than per-trade.
surv.novelty: All prior work tried to SELECT entries. No probe built a dedicated anti-pattern environment-veto from ORDERED noise signatures (re-sweeps, whipsaw CHoCH, two-sided bubbles). It inverts the lens: detect-bad rather than detect-good, using the same RAW streams as a regime classifier.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: It doesn't try to beat the right-tail by selection — it protects it. The right-tail edge survives only if the body of median-stop losers (concentrated in noisy regimes) is suppressed. By vetoing the loss-dense environment, the few right-tail winners are no longer drowned by adjacent cluster-losses, making the thin edge survivable and the streak bounded — exactly the failure mode (concentration + clustering) the report identified.
surv.sharpest_reason: It is the only proposal that attacks the report's actual diagnosed failure mode instead of repeating select-good. The engine report concludes entry-selection has no alpha here and that losers are CONCENTRATED + CLUSTERED in chop/contra-phase noise, with edge living in regime/risk-shaping. This is a pure detect-bad environment-veto (re-swept sweeps + whipsaw CHoCH + two-sided bubbles = textbook balance/two-sided-initiative auction), causal SHIFT1 over a 30-bar window with forward-only hysteresis — exactly the L2/BPT 4H winning lens (convergence ELIMINATES bad environments even when no single feature selects the runner). It is orthogonal to the already-weak NAS-in-zone/sweep/EMA select triggers because it filters environments, not entries. Streak-cut rationale is mechanically sound (loss clusters by construction live in whipsaw regimes; hysteresis prevents re-enabling mid-cluster). Two honest caveats keep it at 7.5 not higher: (1) WR-lift is dilution-mechanical, and right-tail reversals often EMERGE from whipsaw/climax — must verify the veto doesn't suppress the few winners it's meant to protect; (2) 5+ free thresholds (a/whipsaw/two_sided counts, M, hysteresis) tunable on the same 8 blocks = medium fit risk, so it must be pre-registered as risk-shaping and validated with leave-one-block-out + null permutation + a density check on the bubble/CHoCH streams, never threshold-locked on calibration.

surv.name: STOP_RUN_VACUUM
surv.angle: A real spring breaches a swing-low/EQL on a volume+range EXPANSION spike and then snaps back through the level within 1-2 bars (liquidity vacuum, no supply met). A continuation breakdown instead ACCEPTS below on flat/rising volume. Classify the breach by the 2-3 bars AFTER it, not the breach event itself.
surv.raw_recipe: Causal, SHIFT1 on SMC. Find prior swing-low SL = lowest-low of k=10..20 bar fractal (t<=j-2) OR latest EQL price. breach = min(low)[j-4..j] < SL*(1-eps). reclaim = close[j]>SL. Then: vac_speed = bars from breach-low bar to first close-back-above SL (require <=2); thrust_vol_z = volume z-score vs trailing-50 median on breach bar (require >=1.0, tick-vol used RELATIVELY); followthru_fail = the 2 bars after breach-low make NO new low. Fire LONG at close[j] iff reclaim AND vac_speed<=2 AND thrust_vol_z>=1.0 AND followthru_fail. Mirror SHORT on swing-high/EQH.
surv.lifts_wr_how: Separates the snap-back spring (trapped sellers covering through the level) from the breakdown-that-holds, which was the bulk of losers. vac_speed<=2 + vol-z is the institutional signature the basic failed_breakdown (0/791) ignored entirely (no speed/volume).
surv.cuts_streak_how: In a genuine downtrend, breaches ACCEPT so vac_speed is never satisfied; the feature stays 0 across the whole bear leg, firing no longs into the trend = no loss cluster.
surv.novelty: Prior failed_breakdown used close-beyond-edge with NO post-breach speed or volume confirmation and was bolted onto the NAS-in-zone universe (fired 0/791). This is universe-independent (any swept swing-low) and reads the 2-bar reaction + volume expansion.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: The corpus right-tail trades ARE the snap-back springs; basic triggers diluted them with accepting-breakdowns. Conditioning on snap-back speed + thrust volume concentrates the universe onto the right tail instead of sampling around it.
surv.sharpest_reason: Causal probe on RAW (universe-independent swing-low breach+reclaim, entry close[j], SL=breach-low, +2R/-1R first-touch) CONFIRMS the structural direction: snap-back springs (vac_speed<=2 AND thrust_vol_z>=1 AND followthru_fail) outcome-separate from accepting breakdowns — WR 40.5% vs 34.9% and expR +0.214 vs +0.048, capturing the bulk of positive expectancy versus 37.1% for all-reclaim. This is the first trap feature with a measured outcome separation and a clean Auction rationale (trapped-seller cover vs acceptance below), distinct from failed_breakdown (0/791, no speed/volume, NAS-bolted) and single-breach sweep+reclaim. KEEP. BUT two real caveats keep score moderate, not high: (1) as-specified it fires ~1300 times = 12.5 trades/week, 3-12x over the 1-5/wk budget — it is a universe filter, not yet a selective entry; tightening to budget could lift OR collapse WR, so fitting_risk is medium. (2) The streak-cut claim ('stays 0 across the bear leg') is NOT supported: it fires heavily in every block (138-479), so the trend-silence mechanism is unproven at this threshold. WR 40.5% is at the band floor with only +5.6pp lift. Net: structurally sound, novel, causal, lift-direction confirmed empirically — promote to refinement (add room-ahead/depth-of-grab/wick-dominance conditioning to reach 1-5/wk and re-test whether WR holds and streak-silence materializes), do not deploy as-is.

surv.name: DOUBLE_SWEEP_DIVERGENCE
surv.angle: The cleanest grab-and-reverse is the SECOND sweep of the same pool: price pokes a low, bounces, pokes it again (equal/marginally-lower) but on LOWER volume + SMALLER range AND with RSI making a higher low. Two failed breaks = pool defended; first-poke stops already gone, so the second poke is the fill, not a fresh break.
surv.raw_recipe: Causal. Detect two local lows L1@t1, L2@t2 (t1<t2<=j) with L2 in [L1*(1-0.15*ATR/px), L1], separated by a bounce (local high > both by >=0.5ATR). vol2_lt_vol1 = vol(L2 bar)<vol(L1 bar); range2_lt_range1 = (h-l)(L2)<(h-l)(L1); rsi_div = rsi(L2 bar)>rsi(L1 bar). Fire LONG at close[j] (first close back above L1 after L2) iff vol2_lt_vol1 AND rsi_div AND range2_lt_range1. Mirror SHORT on EQH/swing-highs with RSI lower-high.
surv.lifts_wr_how: The volume+range+RSI triple-divergence hard-separates exhausted-hunt-that-reverses from momentum-break-that-continues (continuation has vol2>=vol1 and confirming RSI, so it is filtered out).
surv.cuts_streak_how: Requires a SECOND poke, which cannot occur during a clean one-way leg, so no fires against a strong trend; the chop/trend killer is built into the geometry.
surv.novelty: Prior sweep+reclaim used ONE breach. Two-sweep on the SAME pool with cross-feature divergence (vol AND range AND RSI together) was never computed. RSI was only ever a context column, never a divergence read on swept lows.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: Double-sweeps are rarer (fits 1-5/wk) and carry the highest reverse-probability of any trap geometry; the right tail is built from a few high-conviction reversals and this is the precise filter that isolates them rather than averaging over all single sweeps.
surv.sharpest_reason: Causally clean and structurally sound: the SECOND poke of the same pool (first-poke stops already swept, so the retest is the fill not a fresh break) read through a triple effort/momentum divergence (vol2<vol1 AND range2<range1 AND RSI higher-low) is a genuine exhaustion separator, and RSI-as-divergence-on-swept-lows was only ever a context column, never computed this way — so it is NOT redundant with the single-breach sweep+reclaim that failed (theory #2, n17, killed as SMALL_N_ARTIFACT). The geometry self-excludes one-way legs, giving a real (not by-omission) streak-cut rationale, and double-sweeps are naturally rare → fits the 1-5/wk target. THE HONEST RISK IS HIGH-N-FIT: stacking a second-poke requirement plus a 3-way conjoint divergence gate on an already-rare geometry will drive n toward single digits — exactly the right-tail substrate where the engine report's central finding bites (every meta-quality cut is rare, driven by few trades, not robust leave-one-out). KEEP only because (a) the relaxed investigative meta explicitly invites bold trap-geometry at fit risk, (b) it clears all three hard-CUT criteria (causal, real rationale, non-redundant divergence read), and (c) it is the one trap variant whose rarity matches the frequency band. Test ONLY inside a convergence/elimination stack (per the team's own cross-cutting note) and pre-register as risk-shaping, never standalone alpha. Note: this is literally feature #2 of the team's own TRAP_FEATURES_PROPOSALS backlog, so it is a refinement of a planned lane, not an outside-the-box discovery.

surv.name: TRAPPED_BREAKOUT_FUEL
surv.angle: After an EQH/range-high breaks UP and FAILS (close back below within N bars), every breakout buyer is offside with sell-stops below the range = a magnet. Quantify the trapped cohort by the VOLUME transacted above the broken high before the failure; that book is the fuel for the flush.
surv.raw_recipe: Causal, SHIFT1 on SMC. RH = recent EQH or k-bar swing-high (t<=j). breakout = max(high)[window]>RH*(1+eps) AND some close>RH. failure = close[j]<RH. trapped_vol = sum(volume) of bars whose close>RH in the window; trapped_vol_z = vs trailing-50 median (tick-vol RELATIVE). bars_above_RH = count of bars that closed>RH. Fire SHORT at close[j]<RH iff failure AND trapped_vol_z>=2.0 AND bars_above_RH<=4. Contrarian LONG: arm flush-target=range-low RL; if within M bars price sweeps RL and snaps back (feature-1 logic) the offside-long flush completed = highest-quality long.
surv.lifts_wr_how: trapped_vol_z sizes the fuel: small trap = weak follow-through (skip), big trap = strong directional flush where WR lives. bars_above_RH<=4 removes real breakouts that based and held (those are longs, not traps).
surv.cuts_streak_how: A sustained breakout makes bars_above_RH large so the feature never fires; you do not fade a genuine trend repeatedly, the classic streak-killer for fade strategies.
surv.novelty: NO corpus feature measures the SIZE of the trapped cohort (volume transacted in the failed excursion). All prior breakout logic was binary (broke/didn't). Quantifying the offside book as fuel is new.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: The biggest 15M reversals are upthrust-failures with heavy trapped volume (blow-off top into a flush); right-tail magnitude correlates with cohort size, so sizing it directly targets the magnitude tail the binary triggers could not see.
surv.sharpest_reason: Causally clean and genuinely novel: the corpus only ever had a BINARY failed_breakdown that fired 0/791 because it was bolted onto the NAS-in-zone universe; this is universe-independent (raw EQH/swing-high, all inputs confirmed present: EQH labels, per-bar volume, SHIFT1 SMC) and is the first feature to SIZE the trapped cohort. The streak-cut mechanism is the strongest part and structurally airtight: a sustained real breakout makes bars_above_RH large so the fade NEVER fires into a genuine trend (trend-immunity by construction). The one real hazard, and why this is KEEP-with-caveat not a high score: the WR-lift hinges entirely on trapped_vol_z>=2.0 over TICK-VOLUME, which standing memory flags unreliable and which already produced one RETRACTED artifact in this exact program (volume x bear confluence vanished under real Session-VP volume). It uses volume relatively/z-scored (the mandated mitigation) so it is not an auto-CUT, but the lift must be re-tested with a volume-FREE proxy (bars_above_RH + range-excursion only) to prove the edge is not just the unreliable channel; otherwise it risks reproducing the same right-tail wall (expectancy in ~5% of trades, fails leave-one-out) the other 4 theories hit.

surv.name: EQ_FAKEOUT_TIMEPOLARITY
surv.angle: SMC EQH/EQL are engineered liquidity. A reversing fakeout spends MINIMAL time beyond the level (instantaneous stop sweep) and sweeps via WICK not body; a true break spends time and closes accepting. Read EQ by time-in-excursion + wick-vs-body, which the basic reclaim detector missed.
surv.raw_recipe: Causal, SHIFT1 on SMC. EQ level = nearest EQL(long)/EQH(short), t<=j. excursion_bars = count in [j-6,j] with low<EQL (or high>EQH). wick_sweep = on deepest breach bar, both open and close stayed above EQL (only the low pierced). body_accept_bars = count of bars that CLOSED beyond the level. fakeout_strength = (EQL - min_low)/ATR (grab depth). Fire LONG iff close[j]>EQL AND excursion_bars<=3 AND wick_sweep AND body_accept_bars<=1. Mirror SHORT.
surv.lifts_wr_how: wick_sweep + body_accept<=1 exactly separates swept-the-stops-and-rejected from broke-and-closed-through, the latter being the loser the EQ fade kept buying; time-in-excursion is a continuous quality score for the cut.
surv.cuts_streak_how: When the level genuinely breaks, body_accept_bars climbs and the gate closes, so no repeated fading of a level that has actually given way; caps consecutive losses at a broken EQ.
surv.novelty: EQH/EQL were only ever used as price levels (room_to_run, sweep_reclaim). Reading them by WICK-vs-BODY and TIME-beyond-level (the microstructure of the sweep) and using EQ as the trigger itself with a polarity/time read is unexplored.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: Institutional EQ sweeps that reverse hard are wick-dominant and fast; the right-tail reversals share this microstructure. Filtering to wick+fast isolates the tail-producing fakeouts from the body-accept breaks that produced the median-stop losers.
surv.sharpest_reason: Verified causally feasible against the actual primitives: smc_events carry EQH/EQL price+t (717 labels, 343/791 candidates have an EQ within 96 bars) and per-bar series OHLC lets wick-vs-body, excursion_bars and body_accept_bars be computed SHIFT1 with no look-ahead. The novel delta is real vs the tested-weak detector: the existing _DA_sweep_reclaim_feasibility probe only did a BINARY reclaim-in-<=2-bars test (166/343), never reading wick-dominant-sweep vs body-accept polarity or time-in-excursion — and wick=rejection / body=acceptance is textbook auction liquidity-grab microstructure, exactly the failure mode (the fade kept buying body-accept breaks). KEEP, not CUT, because it is neither redundant-identical (it adds a principled axis the weak detector lacked) nor pure curve-fit (mechanism is structural). BUT fitting risk is HIGH: it rides the same EQ-reclaim chassis that already hit the wall, and stacks a 3-clause conjunctive gate (excursion<=3 AND wick_sweep AND body_accept<=1) with tunable thresholds onto a thin base, so surviving n after LONG/SHORT split will be small and right-tail-concentrated — test it but pre-register the thresholds and report n and WR on the firing subset before believing any lift; streak-cut only protects against re-fading the SAME broken level, not broad bad-environment clusters.

surv.name: LIQUIDITY_MAGNET_REJECTION
surv.angle: Price hunts the most obvious resting liquidity (clean prior swing extreme, EQH/EQL, virgin OB edge, round level), takes it, and rejects within 1 bar. Pre-identify WHERE stops MUST sit and only trade the rejection AT that magnet; entries elsewhere are noise. OB-zone confluence is a secondary LOCATION filter, not the trigger.
surv.raw_recipe: Causal, SHIFT1 on SMC/OB. Magnet candidates (t<=j-1): nearest untouched-since-creation swing-low (long), latest EQL, virgin DEMAND OB edge. magnet_hit = bar low pierces a magnet in [j-2,j]. instant_reject = within 1 bar close back above magnet AND piercing bar closes in top 1/3 of its range. confluence = number of distinct magnet types coinciding within 0.5ATR (stacked liquidity). room = dist_to_next_opposite_magnet in trade direction, require >=2.0 ATR. Fire LONG iff instant_reject AND confluence>=1 AND room>=2.0ATR. Mirror SHORT.
surv.lifts_wr_how: Stacked magnets + instant-rejection candle + room-ahead is a multi-factor orthogonal convergence (location, reaction, payoff) the single-event sweep_reclaim (12/791, no lift) lacked; convergence is a true quality gradient, not a relabeling.
surv.cuts_streak_how: Requires a magnet to BE hit and rejected; in a one-way trend the magnet is run THROUGH (no instant_reject) so no fire, structurally excluding the chop/trend that generated streaks.
surv.novelty: No prior feature pre-registered WHERE stops sit and demanded rejection AT that exact location with stacking + a room gate. Prior work detected sweeps reactively anywhere; this is location-pre-committed + multi-magnet stacking + payoff gate.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: The rare high-R reversals all pivot off obvious-liquidity rejections with room to the opposite structure; gating jointly on location+rejection+room is the convergence that concentrates the universe onto those pivots instead of averaging over all sweeps, directly attacking the right-tail concentration.
surv.sharpest_reason: Causally clean (all blocks—zone_virgin, EQL/EQH, swing-low pierce+reclaim, ATR room—already exist in primitives; _DA_sweep_reclaim_feasibility.py proves the pierce/reclaim compute works) and structurally sound. BUT two sharp caveats. (1) It is NOT new to the project: it is verbatim feature #6 in TRAP_FEATURES_PROPOSALS.md (same name/angle/recipe/rationale), an already-written Ring-2 backlog item never fired—zero novelty vs the existing backlog, only novel vs the 4 tested-failed theories. (2) Its conjunctive stacking (confluence>=1 AND room>=2ATR AND instant-reject top-1/3 AND 1-bar reclaim) makes the already-rare single-event sweep+reclaim STRICTER—Theory 2 (sweep+reclaim) already died as SMALL_N_ARTIFACT (n17, 2 trades=83%WR, leave-one-out -9R), and tightening it lands squarely back in that few-trades/one-window non-robust failure mode the engine report flagged as the irreducible right-tail wall. WR-lift claim is therefore low-plausibility. The one redeeming, KEEP-worthy angle: under the now-RELAXED meta (streak<=5, no DD floor), its streak-cut mechanism ('magnet run THROUGH in a trend = no fire') is structurally real and orthogonal to magnitude—worth ONE test as a conv>=2 ENVIRONMENT-ELIMINATION gate (per the cross-cutting note echoing the validated L2/BPT 4H convergence-eliminates-bad-environments finding), NOT as a standalone WR-lifting trigger. KEEP narrowly, scoped to elimination/streak-cut, with high fitting-risk and the duplicate-of-backlog-#6 fact explicit.

surv.name: KILLZONE_BIRTH_PEDIGREE
surv.angle: Auction/liquidity: WHERE in the session-day the setup is BORN encodes who is in control. London-open (07:00-09:00 UTC) and NY-open (13:00-15:00 UTC) kill-zones are when institutional liquidity runs the prior session's pools; setups born there ride genuine displacement. Setups born in the Asia drift / NY-lunch / late-NY-fade windows are positioning noise that mean-reverts. The corpus mixed all hours into one bucket, diluting the few high-pedigree entries with structurally-doomed dead-hour entries.
surv.raw_recipe: Per candidate, compute killzone = bucket of (entry_t mod 86400) into UTC windows: ASIA[22:00-06:00), LONDON_KZ[06:00-09:00), LONDON_MID[09:00-12:00), NY_KZ[12:00-15:00), NY_PM[15:00-18:00), CLOSE_DRIFT[18:00-22:00). All from entry_t (close of confirmation bar) — purely causal, no look-ahead. Add killzone_quality = 1 if killzone in {LONDON_KZ, NY_KZ} else 0. Refine with directional alignment: in LONDON_KZ/NY_KZ also compute prev_session_range_swept = did the breach/reclaim that birthed the candidate take out the high(short)/low(long) of the PRIOR session's range (sessions split at 22:00 UTC, range = max(h)/min(l) of that completed window, t<=entry_t). pedigree_score = killzone_quality + int(prev_session_range_swept). hour_utc already in CSV; this is its first USE as a gate not a column.
surv.lifts_wr_how: Stratify WR by killzone bucket. Hypothesis grounded in XAU microstructure: LONDON_KZ + NY_KZ entries that ALSO swept the prior-session pool are the institutional-displacement subset — these should carry materially higher WR (initiative rejecting value) while ASIA/CLOSE_DRIFT entries are the chop substrate dragging WR to 27-49%. Keeping only pedigree_score>=1 (or >=2) is a hard WR-lift filter that removes whole dead-hour cohorts rather than re-labeling individual trades.
surv.cuts_streak_how: Loss streaks in 24h-traded XAU cluster in the dead hours (Asia drift, NY-lunch, Friday-close fade) where price aimlessly oscillates and every entry-selection setup is a coin-flip. Hard-blocking ASIA + CLOSE_DRIFT + NY_PM removes the time-of-day where consecutive losses are manufactured. A bad sequence physically cannot accumulate if no trades fire in those windows — the streak cap is enforced by the clock, not by post-hoc geometry.
surv.novelty: hour_utc and dow exist as CSV columns but FEATURE_MAP explicitly says 'HTF=context, not gate' and they were never used as a discriminator — only displayed. No prior theory bucketed entries into XAU-specific kill-zones, and none combined kill-zone with prior-session pool-sweep. The session-birth concept appears only in an unfinished _DA probe; it was never built into the feature set or tested for WR lift.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: The right-tail runners in the corpus are displacement moves, and displacement on XAU is overwhelmingly born in the London/NY kill-zones — that is when the volume to fuel a multi-day runner actually arrives. Basic triggers fired across all 24h, so the right-tail entries were a needle hidden in a haystack of dead-hour noise. Conditioning the universe ON the kill-zone concentrates onto the hours that PRODUCE the tail instead of sampling around the clock, which is precisely the right-tail-concentration attack the geometric triggers lacked.
surv.sharpest_reason: Empirically (real outcome engine, n=714): KZ-only LONDON_KZ+NY_KZ = WR 42.3% vs ALL 33.9% (+8.4pp, lands in relaxed 40-50% band, sumR +23.7 vs ALL -49.6) — a real, causal, never-gated lift (FEATURE_MAP explicitly says time = 'context not gate'; hour_utc existed only as a displayed column). So KEEP for the WR-lift / dead-hour-streak-cut angle. BUT the proposal's headline runner/right-tail rationale is INVERTED by the data: 52 of 87 runners (60%) are born OUTSIDE the kill-zones, ASIA alone holding the most (35) — blocking ASIA+NY_PM would discard the majority of the corpus's right tail. The lift is a blunt clock effect, not the claimed institutional-pedigree mechanism (adjacent LONDON_MID 09-12h is the WORST bucket at 19.1%, while 'dead' NY_PM beats the average at 39.3%), and the prev_session_sweep refinement (pedigree>=2) was never the source of the lift and remains untested. Keep it as a cheap orthogonal WR/streak filter; reject its runner-concentration story; sub-window/jackknife stability still unproven (medium fit risk).

surv.name: AGE_OF_MOVE_DECAY
surv.angle: Microstructure/age: an impulse leg has a half-life. Entering a continuation/reversal EARLY in a fresh leg (the leg is young, few bars since origin, displacement still expanding) is structurally different from entering LATE (the leg is old, has already traveled most of its range, momentum is decaying into distribution). The corpus treated a 3-bar-old move and a 60-bar-old move as identical setups. Old moves are where you buy the top of the runner = median-stop losers; young moves are where the magnitude tail lives.
surv.raw_recipe: Use the existing leg map (leg_dir per bar). For each candidate at bar j: leg_age_bars = j - (first bar of the current leg, the leg-origin pivot, all t<=entry_t). leg_traveled_atr = (entry_close - leg_origin_price)/atr in leg direction. leg_extension_pct = leg_traveled_atr / (rolling median historical leg-travel of the last K completed legs in this block, computed only from legs that closed before entry_t — causal). young_move = 1 if leg_age_bars <= 12 AND leg_extension_pct <= 0.5 (move has spent <half its typical range). Also time_in_leg_z = (leg_age_bars - median past-leg-duration)/MAD, all from completed prior legs. Fire/keep only young_move; flag old_move (leg_extension_pct>=1.0) as a hard skip.
surv.lifts_wr_how: WR should be monotone-decreasing in leg_extension_pct: entries in the first third of a leg's typical travel win at a higher rate (room ahead, momentum intact) than entries in the last third (no room, exhaustion). Stratifying and keeping only young_move trims the late-leg cohort that contributes most of the 50%+ losses, mechanically lifting WR. This is orthogonal to room_to_run (which measures distance to opposing structure) — age measures how MUCH of the move is already spent regardless of where the next wall is.
surv.cuts_streak_how: Loss streaks in trending markets come from repeatedly entering a leg that is already extended (chasing). Once leg_extension_pct crosses 1.0 the gate closes for the rest of that leg, so you cannot fire trade after trade into an exhausted move — the late-leg loss cluster is structurally truncated. When a fresh leg is born the gate re-opens, naturally pacing entries to one per young-leg.

surv.name: SESSION_OPEN_DRIVE_FADE_vs_FOLLOW
surv.angle: Auction: the first 1-2 hours of London and NY set the session's auction premise. An 'open-drive' (price opens and trends one direction immediately, accepting away from the open) signals a directional session — trade WITH it. An 'open-auction/rejection' (price probes one side of the open then reverses back through it = failed open drive) signals a rotational/two-sided session — fade the probe. The QUALITY of an entry depends on whether it agrees with the session's already-revealed open character, which the corpus never read.
surv.raw_recipe: Define session anchors at 07:00 UTC (London) and 13:00 UTC (NY). For each candidate at bar j, find the most recent session open <= entry_t and compute open_price = open of the first bar of that session. drive_extent_atr = (close at j vs open_price)/atr. opening_range = [min(l),max(h)] of the first 4 bars (1h) after the open (only if those bars have t<=entry_t — else feature undefined/skip). session_character: OPEN_DRIVE_UP if price accepted above OR-high without trading back below open; OPEN_REJECT_UP if price probed above OR-high then closed back below open (failed drive). open_alignment = 1 if candidate direction agrees with session_character (LONG in OPEN_DRIVE_UP or after OPEN_REJECT_DOWN-fade-long), else 0. All anchors/ranges are completed-bar, causal.
surv.lifts_wr_how: Entries that agree with the session's revealed open character (drive-follow or rejection-fade) should win materially more than entries that fight it. The corpus fired setups irrespective of whether the session had already declared trend-day or rotation-day; gating on open_alignment removes the counter-character cohort (e.g. longing into a session that open-drove down) that is a structural loss generator, lifting WR toward 40-50.
surv.cuts_streak_how: On a strong trend-day, every counter-character entry is a loss; open_alignment blocks them all at once, so you cannot string together fades against a driving session. On a rotation-day it blocks chasing the breakout that gets faded. Either way the session-character gate prevents the specific repeated-mistake that builds streaks in directional vs rotational regimes.
surv.novelty: No feature in the corpus used the session OPEN as a reference price or computed an opening-range / open-drive-vs-rejection classification. Session was only ever a categorical hour bucket for display. Open-drive auction logic (a core futures-auction concept) has never been applied to this XAU 15M dataset.

Reading the open character and trading only with it concentrates the universe onto the session type that manufactures the right tail.
surv.sharpest_reason: First feature to use the SESSION OPEN as a reference price and classify the session as trend-day (open-drive) vs rotation-day (open-reject) — a real Market-Profile auction concept never applied here. It operates at the ENVIRONMENT/session-character altitude, not bar-i geometry, so it is genuinely orthogonal to the already-fraco isolated triggers (NAS-in-zone / sweep+reclaim / pullback-EMA) and squarely attacks the corpus's RIGHT-TAIL diagnosis at the correct level: trend-days manufacture the 15M runners.
