surv.name: LEG_FRACTAL_FLIP (the swing sequence just flipped LH/LL -> HH/HL on the entry timeframe, freshly)
surv.angle: Trajectory of structure, not a single CHoCH. The cleanest reversals occur when the recent swing fractal sequence INVERTS its polarity for the first time: a run of lower-highs/lower-lows that produces exactly ONE fresh higher-low (for a long). The FRESHNESS (this is the 1st HL after >=2 LLs) is the tell — a mature HH/HL chain is a trend already running (late), while a stale LL chain with no flip is continuation-down (loser). micro_choch was binary and macro-conditioned; this reads the actual HL/LH count trajectory.
surv.raw_recipe: Build swing pivots from RAW OHLC only (no SMC): a pivot-high at bar k if h[k] is the max of [k-w..k+w] with w=3, fully closed (k+w<=j). Same for pivot-lows. Over the last ~40 bars (t<=j) extract the ordered sequence of pivot lows. count_LL = number of consecutive lower pivot-lows ending most recently; then detect if the LAST pivot-low is HIGHER than its predecessor = fresh_HL=1. fresh_flip = (count_LL>=2 in the run just before) AND (fresh_HL=1) AND (the higher-low pivot is confirmed, i.e. its right shoulder closed at t<=j). Require entry close[j] above that HL's high (the flip is being acted on). Mirror with pivot-highs for SHORT (LH after >=2 HHs of highs... i.e. fresh lower-high after rising highs).
surv.lifts_wr_how: Isolates the FIRST structural inversion (where reversal R lives) from both (a) stale continuation chains with no flip (the persistent loser) and (b) mature trends already 3+ HH/HL deep (entered too late, low remaining R). The count-of-prior-LLs gate is the quality gradient: deeper prior down-run + clean single flip = higher conviction.
surv.cuts_streak_how: A grinding bear leg produces a continuous LL sequence with no fresh_HL for many bars → feature is 0 across the whole leg → zero longs fired during the streak-producing down-grind.
surv.novelty: The corpus only ever read structure via SMC BOS/CHoCH labels (binary, repaint-prone, macro-conditioned). Computing the raw PIVOT SEQUENCE (count of consecutive LLs then a fresh HL) from OHLC fractals — the trajectory of the swing chain and its freshness — has never been done. It is also SMC-independent so it cannot inherit SMC repaint bias.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: Right-tail reversals are born at the structural inversion bar; sampling anywhere else on the leg averages over losers. Gating on the FIRST flip after a deep one-way run concentrates the universe on the inversion bars, and the prior-LL-depth feature ranks them by how stretched the move was — directly proxying the snap-back magnitude.
surv.sharpest_reason: Genuinely novel along the dimension that matters: the corpus only ever read structure as STATE (binary leg_dir = sign of last confirmed k=2 pivot; SMC BOS/CHoCH binary labels), never as the ORDERED COUNT of consecutive same-side pivots + detection of the FIRST polarity flip. It is also distinct from the already-weak triggers: micro_choch was binary+macro-conditioned, sweep+reclaim was a single-event breach, pullback-EMA fires DURING a trend — none read prior-run depth or first-inversion freshness.

surv.name: RSI_PATH_SHAPE (momentum divergence + slope-inflection across the approach, not the RSI value)
surv.angle: RSI was only ever a static context column. Its VALUE at entry is nearly useless; its PATH is informative. The winning approach shows a momentum trajectory that diverges from price (price makes a lower low, RSI makes a higher low = sellers weakening) AND an RSI slope that inflects from falling to rising right at entry. This is the momentum derivative of the trajectory, complementary to the price-derivative feature #1.
surv.raw_recipe: Pure causal, RSI is non-repainting (it is a study value on closed bars). Identify the two most recent price-low pivots p1(t1)<p2(t2)<=j with price[p2]<=price[p1] (lower or equal price low). rsi_div = rsi[p2] > rsi[p1] + margin (e.g. +3) = bullish divergence. Then slope-inflection: rsi_slope_early = rsi[j-2]-rsi[j-5]; rsi_slope_late = rsi[j]-rsi[j-2]; inflect = rsi_slope_early<0 AND rsi_slope_late>0 (RSI turned up at entry). Also rsi_thrust = rsi[j]-rsi[j-1] >= some positive threshold (kick of momentum). Fire-quality HIGH when rsi_div AND inflect. Mirror for SHORT (lower-high in RSI on equal/higher price highs + downward inflection).
surv.lifts_wr_how: The price-vs-momentum divergence is a hard separator of 'exhausting move that reverses' (RSI refuses to confirm the new price extreme) from 'momentum-confirmed continuation' (RSI confirms = the trend loser). Slope-inflection adds the timing: it gates entry to the bar momentum actually turns, removing premature catches.
surv.cuts_streak_how: In a genuine trend against the trade, RSI confirms each new extreme (no divergence) and never inflects → feature 0 → no counter-trend entries during the run = streak suppressed. The divergence simply cannot form in clean momentum.
surv.novelty: RSI appears in candidates_features purely as a static value column — never as a divergence vs price pivots, never as a slope-inflection. Reading RSI as a 2nd-order PATH (divergence + derivative sign-flip) is unexplored here, and it is orthogonal to the price-path feature #1 so the two can stack as convergence.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: The right-tail reversals systematically carry momentum divergence at their origin (that is what an exhausted leg looks like internally). Basic triggers ignored momentum entirely and so could not distinguish exhaustion from continuation. Gating on divergence+inflection concentrates on the exhaustion pivots that seed the large moves.
surv.sharpest_reason: Causal and structurally sound, and the RSI slope-inflection + thrust derivative-timing layer IS genuinely unexplored (RSI only ever a static column here) and orthogonal to the weak NAS/sweep/EMA triggers. KEEP — but conditionally: the divergence HALF is already a named sub-component of backlog proposal #2 DOUBLE_SWEEP_DIVERGENCE (TRAP_FEATURES_PROPOSALS.md line 42, rsi_div = rsi(L2)>rsi(L1)), so only the inflection/path increment is new. High fitting risk: many tunable knobs (margin, pivot k, slope windows, thrust thr) on a thin right-tail substrate where the engine report already showed every quality recut is rare, few-trade-driven, and fails leave-one-out — this momentum-exhaustion read predictably stacks onto the SAME wall as a standalone WR lifter. Its honest value is as a streak-cutting environment detector inside a conv-elimination stack (the report's own endorsed mode, lines 143-145), since divergence/inflection structurally cannot form in clean momentum. Test as the inflection increment folded into convergence, NOT as a fresh isolated trigger.

surv.name: NAS_ARRIVAL_CADENCE (the TEMPO of the NAS cluster — accelerating cluster at the extreme vs scattered)
surv.angle: Trajectory of the signal generator itself. nas_count_in_zone and nas_density50 are static COUNTS — they say how many, not the RHYTHM. A high-conviction turn shows NAS events ARRIVING FASTER and TIGHTER right at the price extreme (a burst exactly at the low), whereas noise shows NAS scattered evenly across a chop range (constant inter-arrival, no clustering at an extreme). Reading the inter-arrival acceleration of NAS + its coincidence with the price extreme is a trajectory read of conviction.
surv.raw_recipe: From nas_events of matched polarity with t<=j over the last ~60 bars: take their timestamps. inter_arrival = gaps between consecutive matched-NAS. cadence_accel = mean(last 2 gaps) < 0.5*mean(prior gaps) (the cluster is tightening = burst). burst_at_extreme = the most recent NAS fires within 3 bars of the LOWEST low (long) / HIGHEST high (short) of the last 30 bars (the burst coincides with the price extreme, not mid-range). scatter_penalty = number of OPPOSITE-polarity NAS in the same 60-bar window (high = indecision). Fire-quality HIGH when cadence_accel AND burst_at_extreme AND scatter_penalty<=1.
surv.lifts_wr_how: Separates a conviction burst pinned to the extreme (institutions stepping in at the turn) from NAS that merely appears repeatedly across an undecided range (the bidirectional-cluster noise the visual read flagged as the #1 ruido). Same NAS count, opposite quality — the tempo+location is the discriminator the static counts erased.
surv.cuts_streak_how: Chop ranges produce evenly-scattered NAS on BOTH sides (high scatter_penalty, no burst_at_extreme) → feature stays 0 in exactly the bidirectional-cluster environment that the visual gestalt identified as the loss-cluster generator. This is a direct environment SKIP for chop.
surv.novelty: NAS was only ever counted (density, count-in-zone) or used as a binary trigger. The INTER-ARRIVAL acceleration of the NAS stream and its temporal coincidence with the price extreme — the cadence/trajectory of the signal generator — has never been measured. It turns NAS from a trigger into a conviction-rhythm meter.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: The few right-tail turns in the corpus are precisely where NAS clusters tightly AT the extreme (the visual prints show this: ▲BOTTOM burst exactly at the low before the runner). Static counts diluted these bursts with scattered range-NAS. Gating on cadence+extreme-coincidence isolates the burst-at-the-turn that precedes the magnitude leg.
surv.sharpest_reason: Genuinely novel and causally clean: NAS was only ever COUNTED (nas_count_in_zone, nas_density50) or used as a coarse span (nas_cluster_span_bars = j - first_cluster_idx, a single scalar). The proposal's cadence_accel is the 2nd-order rhythm of inter-arrival gaps — a cluster with identical span can have wholly different internal tempo, so it is NOT redundant with span. burst_at_extreme (most-recent NAS within 3 bars of the 30-bar price low/high) adds a temporal coincidence with the extreme that nas_before_touch (a mere boolean ordering vs touch) does not encode. Both are directly motivated by the documented gestalt: VISUAL_READING_PRINTS flags 'clusters densos TOP+BOTTOM em chop = indecisão (#1 ruído)' (= scatter_penalty/no-burst → feature stays 0 in chop = real environment SKIP) and '▲BOTTOM burst no extremo + sweep' as the winner signature (= burst_at_extreme). So the rationale is structural, not curve-fit. THREE caveats keeping this at 6.5 not higher: (1) scatter_penalty overlaps the already-tested nas_density50, which was risk-shaping only and did not lift WR — so the streak-cut leg is partly a re-test of a known-weak chop proxy; the NOVEL alpha rests on cadence_accel+burst_at_extreme, not scatter. (2) High parameter DOF: five free thresholds (0.5 gap-ratio, 3-bar extreme window, 30-bar extreme, 60-bar window, scatter<=1) AND-combined over a corpus with very few right-tail turns = real overfit exposure; must pre-register thresholds and check sub-window stability, never tune jointly on the winners. (3) SPARSITY is the operative limit: cadence_accel needs >=4 matched-NAS in window to be defined, but nas_count_in_zone median=1/max=5 — so the burst-rhythm read only fires on the rare dense clusters and any WR-lift is only validatable on a thin subset. KEEP because it is the single un-attempted NAS-trajectory read, fits the convergent-reading canon (2nd-order generator trajectory, not snapshot), and is cheap/clean to compute — but validate as a sparse conviction-meter on the dense-cluster subset, not as a standalone gate.

surv.name: BUBBLE_EXHAUSTION_FLIP
surv.angle: Order-flow exhaustion read from the Market Order Bubbles channel — never measured beyond 'confluence'. A genuine reversal pivot is NOT where same-color bubbles cluster; it is where a DENSE cluster of one polarity (heavy SELL bubbles into a low / BUY bubbles into a high) is immediately followed by a DROUGHT of that polarity and the FIRST opposite-color bubble. Effort (flurry of aggressive market orders pushing the extreme) followed by sudden silence = the aggressive cohort is spent; the order book has been cleared and the side that was hitting can no longer find follow-through. This is Wyckoff effort/result read directly from the order-flow channel instead of from candle range.
surv.raw_recipe: Provenance: bubbles live in RAW (pine_shapes_bubbles / Market Order Bubbles, BUY=green / SELL=red, size=intensity, per-plot s/m/L) — present in the original gz though not serialized into the current primitives/*.json snapshot, so re-extract the bubble activations per bar with SHIFT1 like other repainting indicators. For a LONG at confirmation bar j: within trailing window [j-12,j-2] compute sell_pressure = sum of SELL-bubble intensities (weight L=3,m=2,s=1) and count. Define CLUSTER = sell_pressure_z >= 1.0 vs trailing-50-bar median AND the cluster's lowest-low bar is the leg extreme. Define DROUGHT = in the 2-4 bars after the cluster's extreme, zero new SELL bubbles AND >=1 BUY bubble appears. Fire LONG at close[j] (j = first close back above the cluster-extreme low) only if CLUSTER then DROUGHT then BUY-bubble, all t<=j. Mirror for SHORT (BUY-bubble cluster into a high then BUY-drought + first SELL bubble). All bubble reads SHIFT1.
surv.lifts_wr_how: The bubble channel directly proxies aggressive market-order flow, which candle/zone/EMA geometry cannot see. Separating 'sellers still hitting' (cluster continues = loser) from 'sellers exhausted, first buyer steps in' (cluster->drought->flip = winner) is an orthogonal order-flow gate. Basic triggers fired on geometry while sellers were still aggressive; this fires only once aggressive supply has visibly dried up, which is exactly the WR-bearing subset.
surv.cuts_streak_how: In a one-way bear leg the SELL-bubble cluster never goes into drought (sellers keep printing) and no BUY bubble appears, so the feature stays 0 across the whole down-leg — zero longs fired into the trend = no loss cluster. Drought is structurally impossible during sustained one-sided flow.
surv.novelty: The engine has used bubbles ONLY as a binary same-color confluence column (FEATURE_MAP section G). The DYNAMIC of cluster-then-drought-then-flip (a time-derivative of order-flow intensity) has never been computed. No prior feature measured the DISAPPEARANCE of bubbles as signal.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: Right-tail reversals in the corpus begin at the exact bar aggressive supply/demand exhausts — invisible to swing/zone/EMA. Anchoring entry to the order-flow exhaustion flip targets the ORIGIN of the magnitude move, not a geometric point along it, which is why basic triggers diluted the tail and this concentrates onto it.
surv.sharpest_reason: Causally feasible and genuinely novel: I verified in the RAW gz that bubbles ARE serialized per-bar (activations[] with bar_index/time/plot_id — the recipe's claim that they're 'not serialized' is wrong, they're already present), polarity is clean (0/754 bars carry both BUY and SELL), and ~6 bubble-bars/day gives enough material for a 1-5/wk gate. Dedup on (bar_index,plot_id) resolves the 19x repaint; SHIFT1 is already standard. Bubbles were only ever used as a binary same-color confluence column (FEATURE_MAP G), so the time-derivative cluster->drought->flip read is new and orthogonal to the weak-tested NAS-in-zone/sweep/EMA triggers — it reads aggressive order-flow none of them see, and the drought condition gives a real structural streak-cut (no longs fire in one-way down-legs). Two caveats, not killers: (1) DEGRADED INPUT — every serialized shapes value is exactly 1, so the recipe's continuous 'sum of L=3/m=2/s=1 intensities' z-score is NOT recoverable; size survives only as 3 discrete plot-tiers (plot_0/2/4=BUY s/m/L), and bubble price-location must be reconstructed by joining activation time to OHLC. (2) PRIOR — this is still an entry-selection feature on the documented right-tail substrate where 3 orthogonal triggers already hit the wall, and the SAME exhaustion-at-extreme thesis already exists in two volume-based backlog proposals (ABSORPTION_AT_EXTREME, DOUBLE_SWEEP_DIVERGENCE); the bubble channel is a distinct sensor for it but not a distinct hypothesis. KEEP because it plausibly anchors entry to the exhaustion ORIGIN (the one angle that could concentrate rather than dilute the tail) with a non-fit structural rationale — but it must be tested against, not assumed to beat, the right-tail ceiling, and validated with the coarse 3-tier intensity rather than the false continuous one.

surv.name: RSI_REGIME_BREAK_AT_FRESH_ZONE
surv.angle: Two-factor read fusing the RSI channel (used only as a static context column) with zone freshness (lifecycle id never combined with momentum). The veteran tell: at a VIRGIN zone (born but never re-touched), the reaction quality depends on whether RSI was in an EXHAUSTED regime AND then makes a momentum-regime BREAK on the reaction bar. Not classic divergence on swept lows (that is Ring-2 #2) — here it is the SHAPE of RSI's recovery: oversold-stretch into the fresh zone, then RSI snaps back across a momentum threshold (e.g. 30->50 in 1-2 bars) = a momentum-regime change confirming the fresh zone is being defended initiatively, vs a limp RSI that drifts up (absorption, the zone is being consumed).
surv.raw_recipe: For LONG at bar j: find a DEMAND zone (all_boxes.text='DEMAND', SHIFT1) that is VIRGIN (no OHLC re-entry between born_t and j-2) and whose edge is within 0.5*ATR of price[j]. Compute rsi_stretch = min(rsi) over [j-5,j-1] (require <=35, oversold reach into the fresh zone). Compute rsi_snap_speed = bars from that rsi-min to first rsi>=50 (require <=2). Compute rsi_slope = (rsi[j]-rsi[j-2]). Fire LONG at close[j] if zone VIRGIN AND rsi_stretch<=35 AND rsi_snap_speed<=2 AND rsi_slope>0. Mirror SHORT (virgin SUPPLY, rsi_stretch>=65, snap down to <=50 in <=2 bars). All RSI from series (no repaint); zone lifecycle SHIFT1.
surv.lifts_wr_how: Conditions reaction quality on (a) the zone being UNUSED (highest rejection probability per FEATURE_MAP zone_virgin) AND (b) a fast momentum-regime FLIP rather than a drift. The snap-speed<=2 separates initiative defense (winner) from slow absorption (the median-stop loser that drifts up then rolls over). RSI-as-regime is a continuous quality score the binary NAS-in-zone trigger lacked.
surv.cuts_streak_how: Re-tested / mitigated zones are excluded (virgin gate), and a limp RSI (no fast snap) keeps the gate shut — so repeated weak bounces into a decaying zone (the classic chop loss-cluster) never fire. In a real downtrend RSI never reaches an oversold-then-fast-snap state at a fresh demand zone.
surv.novelty: RSI was a static context column (FEATURE_MAP G) and zone freshness a separate registry field (section A); the engine never FUSED RSI momentum-regime dynamics WITH zone-virginity as a joint entry gate. Snap-SPEED of RSI across a regime threshold has never been computed.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: The basic NAS-in-zone trigger fired on every casual zone touch, diluting the tail. The high-R reversals occur specifically at fresh value areas where a fast momentum regime-flip confirms initiative — gating on virgin+fast-snap concentrates the universe onto that exact subset instead of averaging over all touches.
surv.sharpest_reason: Verified in code: RSI is captured only as a static snapshot at entry (detect_candidates.py:123, `S[j]["rsi"]`), and zone_virgin is computed separately (detect_candidates.py:92) — the two were genuinely never fused, and RSI snap-SPEED across a regime threshold has never been computed anywhere in the corpus. Per-bar RSI lives in the continuous primitive series (rsi_by_t), so rsi_stretch/snap_speed/slope are all computable causally close-only/SHIFT1 with zero look-ahead. The structural read (fast momentum-regime flip = initiative defense vs limp drift = absorption/consumption) is coherent with the engine's documented rejection-vs-acceptance core and is a different axis from DOUBLE_SWEEP_DIVERGENCE (#2, which uses RSI higher-low on swept lows). Real but bounded fit risk: it stacks 3 tuned thresholds (stretch<=35, snap_speed<=2, slope>0) on noisy 15M RSI, and the prior wall was precisely that fresh-zone entry-selection is right-tail substrate — so it may thin the universe (helping streak/frequency) more than it lifts WR. Worth ONE bounded test, ideally as a convergence voice not a standalone gate, with snap_speed/stretch robustness swept and jackknifed across the 8 blocks.

surv.name: INTRADAY_VALUE_REJECTION
surv.angle: Price vs developing INTRADAY value area / POC — a channel the 15M engine has never built despite SVP being XAU-canon at 4H. Within the current session, build a rolling volume-weighted value area from the 15M bars so far; the veteran read is whether price is trading ABOVE value (initiative-up / fuel) or has been REJECTED from a value-area extreme back toward POC. The bold edge: only take longs that occur on a REJECTION of the lower value-area edge (val) with a close back INSIDE value, in a session whose POC is RISING (migration up) — i.e. value is being built higher and price defended its lower edge. This is the auction-theory 'acceptance vs rejection' applied to intraday volume distribution, not to the static OB box.
surv.raw_recipe: Session = anchored at each day's first 15M bar (RAW bar time, UTC-derived). Build developing value area causally: for bars so far in the session, bin by price, weight by v (tick-volume used RELATIVELY only), POC=highest-volume bin, VAL/VAH=70% volume band edges (recompute each bar, only bars t<=j). For LONG: vah_rising = POC[j] > POC[j-8] (value migrating up). reject_val = low[j] or low[j-1] pierced VAL but close[j] back inside [VAL,VAH]. Fire LONG at close[j] if reject_val AND vah_rising AND close[j] in lower third of value (room up to POC/VAH). Mirror SHORT (POC falling, rejection of VAH back inside). Volume only relative (within-session distribution shape), never absolute.

surv.name: LEG_MOMENTUM_DECAY_FADE
surv.angle: Relative strength / momentum-decay BETWEEN consecutive impulse legs — a comparison the engine never made. A veteran sizes the conviction of a trend by whether each new leg in the trend direction is WEAKER than the prior one (shorter range, slower velocity, lower RSI thrust = the trend is dying) and conversely refuses to fade a trend whose legs are still ACCELERATING. The edge is a two-sided conviction meter: only take a counter-trend reversal AFTER demonstrable leg-decay (3rd push on fading energy = exhaustion), and use leg-acceleration as a hard veto that cuts streaks of premature fades.
surv.raw_recipe: Define legs from SMC swing structure (BOS/CHoCH pivots, SHIFT1) to segment price into directional impulses with start/end t and price. For the last 3 same-direction legs L1,L2,L3 (most recent = L3, all t<=j): leg_range_i = |end-start price|/ATR; leg_velocity_i = leg_range_i / leg_bars_i; leg_rsi_thrust_i = max RSI excursion during the leg. decay = (range3<range2<range1) AND (velocity3<velocity1) AND (rsi_thrust3<rsi_thrust1) — at least 2 of 3 declining. For a counter-trend LONG (fading a down-sequence): fire at close[j] only if decay AND a CHoCH-up just printed (SHIFT1) AND close[j] reclaims L3 start. ACCELERATION VETO: if range3>range2 OR velocity3>velocity1, set feature=0 (do not fade). Mirror for SHORT.
surv.lifts_wr_how: Conditioning the fade on measured leg-decay separates 'third exhausted push that reverses' from 'fresh accelerating leg' — the latter is the loser that every premature-reversal trigger bought. The 2-of-3 declining-energy requirement is a continuous conviction gradient orthogonal to location-based features.
surv.cuts_streak_how: The acceleration VETO is the explicit streak-killer: while a trend's legs keep getting stronger the feature is forced to 0, so the strategy cannot fade an accelerating trend repeatedly — the single biggest source of consecutive losses in reversal trading is structurally blocked until energy demonstrably fades.
surv.novelty: Every prior feature looked at the CURRENT setup in isolation (zone, sweep, NAS, single leg). No feature COMPARED consecutive legs to each other to read momentum decay/acceleration. Relative strength between pernas is explicitly called out as an unmeasured veteran angle.

Measuring inter-leg energy decay isolates the exhaustion turn and vetoes the premature fades — directly attacking the right-tail concentration the basic triggers averaged over.

surv.name: CHoCH_RETEST_HOLD
surv.angle: The first STRUCTURAL retest after a regime-change CHoCH, read by whether the retest HOLDS without re-breaking the broken structure. The visual reading (prints) says explicitly 'enter on the RETEST post sweep+reclaim, not on the NAS bar' — yet the engine entered on the signal bar and ate premature stops. This feature pre-commits the entry to the retest of the level a CHoCH just flipped, and gates on the retest holding shallow (no full re-break) = the structure has actually changed hands. It is the missing TIMING layer, not a new trigger.
surv.raw_recipe: Detect a CHoCH (SMC text, SHIFT1) at bar c (t<=j) flipping structure up: it broke a prior swing-high SH and printed a higher pivot. The broken level BL = SH (now support). RETEST = after c, price pulls back toward BL: low reaches within 0.3*ATR of BL but close stays > BL for the retest bars. hold = over the retest window [c+1,j] no CLOSE goes below BL (shallow hold, structure defended). retest_depth = (BL - min_low)/ATR (require small, <=0.5: shallow = strong). Fire LONG at close[j] = first bar that closes up off the held retest (close[j]>close[j-1] AND close[j]>BL). Mirror SHORT for down-CHoCH retesting broken support-now-resistance. All SMC SHIFT1.
surv.lifts_wr_how: Entering on a HELD retest (structure flipped and defended) rather than on the impulsive CHoCH bar separates 'genuine regime change that retests and holds' (winner, with the runner ahead) from 'CHoCH that immediately re-breaks back' (the whipsaw loser). The shallow-retest-depth gate is a continuous quality score; deep retests that nearly re-break are filtered out.
surv.cuts_streak_how: If the CHoCH was false the retest re-breaks BL (a close back below) -> hold=False -> no fire, and no re-arm until a NEW CHoCH. This prevents repeatedly entering on every fake structure flip during chop, where CHoCH prints and reverses are the dominant streak source.

The retest-hold microstructure of a CHoCH has never been computed as the trigger.
surv.beats_right_tail_how: The right-tail runners in the prints all begin from a CHoCH that retested and held before the directional leg; the basic triggers entered at the CHoCH bar and got shaken out before the leg, missing the tail. Timing entry to the held retest captures the base of the runner instead of the noisy signal bar — directly recovering the tail the premature entries lost.
